sentences.zh: 汝之職分既定，其無以一二人從行，亦當謹衛門戶。」

translations.literal: Your official duties being fixed, do not have only one or two followers when you go out; you should also carefully guard your gates and doors.」
translations.idiomatic: Your official duties being fixed, do not go about with only one or two followers. You should also guard your gates carefully."

sentences.zh: 遂諭丞相安童增其從人，其為帝所倚眷如此。

translations.literal: Thereupon he instructed Chancellor An Tong to increase his followers; such was the favor in which the Emperor relied upon him.
translations.idiomatic: He then instructed Chancellor An Tong to increase Lu Shirong's retinue. Such was the favor in which the emperor held him.

sentences.zh: 又十有餘日，中書省請罷行御史臺，其所隸按察司隸內臺。

translations.literal: More than ten days later, the Central Secretariat requested abolishing the Branch Censorate and placing its subordinate surveillance commissions under the Inner Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten days later, the Central Secretariat requested abolishing the Branch Censorate and placing its subordinate surveillance commissions under the Inner Censorate.

sentences.zh: 又請隨行省所在立行樞密院。

translations.literal: Also requested establishing Branch Bureaus of Military Affairs wherever Branch Secretariats were located.
translations.idiomatic: They also requested establishing Branch Bureaus of Military Affairs at every location where Branch Secretariats were stationed.

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「行院之事，前日已議，由阿合馬任智自私，欲其子忽辛行省兼兵柄而止。

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「The matter of the branch military bureau was debated the other day; it was stopped because Ahmad, trusting in his own cleverness and acting selfishly, wanted his son Khoshin to hold provincial authority combined with military power.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "The matter of the branch military bureau was debated the other day. It was blocked because Ahmad, trusting in his own cleverness and acting selfishly, wanted his son Khoshin to hold provincial authority together with military command.

sentences.zh: 汝今行之，於事為宜。」

translations.literal: You now carry it out—it is fitting for affairs.」
translations.idiomatic: You may carry it out now—it is the right course for affairs."

sentences.zh: 明日，奏陞六部為二品。

translations.literal: The next day, a memorial was submitted to raise the Six Ministries to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: The next day a memorial was submitted to raise the Six Ministries to second rank.

sentences.zh: 又奏令按察司緫各路錢穀，擇幹濟者用之，其刑名事上御史臺，錢穀由部申省。

translations.literal: A memorial was also submitted ordering Surveillance Commissions to oversee grain revenue in all circuits, selecting capable men to employ them; criminal cases were to be reported to the Censorate, while grain revenue was to be reported from the ministry to the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: They also memorialized that Surveillance Commissions should oversee grain revenue in all circuits, selecting capable men for the task; criminal cases would go to the Censorate, while grain revenue would be reported from the ministry to the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「汝與老臣共議，然後行之可也。」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「Discuss this together with the senior ministers, and then you may carry it out.」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "Discuss this with the senior ministers first, and then you may carry it out."

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，御史臺奏：「中書省請罷行臺，改按察為提刑轉運司，俾兼錢穀。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinyou, the Censorate memorialized: 「The Central Secretariat requests abolishing the Branch Secretariat, changing Surveillance Commissions to Criminal Punishment Transport Offices, making them concurrently oversee grain revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day xinyou, the Censorate memorialized, "The Central Secretariat requests abolishing the Branch Secretariat, converting Surveillance Commissions into Criminal Punishment Transport Offices, and making them concurrently oversee grain revenue.

sentences.zh: 臣等竊惟：初置行臺時，朝廷老臣集議，以為有益，今無所損，不可輒罷。

translations.literal: Your subjects respectfully consider: when the Branch Secretariat was first established, senior ministers of the court assembled in deliberation and deemed it beneficial; now nothing has been harmed—it must not be rashly abolished.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully consider that when the Branch Secretariat was first established, senior ministers of the court deliberated together and judged it beneficial. Nothing has since been harmed—it must not be rashly abolished.

sentences.zh: 且按察司兼轉運，則糾彈之職廢。

translations.literal: Moreover, if Surveillance Commissions concurrently handle transport, the duty of impeachment and censure is abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, if Surveillance Commissions concurrently handle transport, their duty of impeachment and censure is abandoned.

sentences.zh: 請右丞相復與朝廷老臣集議。」

translations.literal: Your subjects request that the Right Chancellor again assemble senior ministers of the court in deliberation.」
translations.idiomatic: We request that the Right Chancellor again assemble the court's senior ministers in deliberation."

sentences.zh: 得旨如所請。

translations.literal: Imperial approval was received as requested.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial approval was granted as requested.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，御史臺奏：「前奉旨，令臣等議罷行臺及兼轉運事。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Censorate memorialized: 「Previously receiving an edict ordering your subjects to deliberate on abolishing the Branch Secretariat and the matter of concurrently handling transport.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, the Censorate memorialized, "By previous edict we were ordered to deliberate on abolishing the Branch Secretariat and on concurrently handling transport.

sentences.zh: 世榮言按察司所任，皆長才舉職之人，可兼錢穀。

translations.literal: Lu Shirong said the men appointed to Surveillance Commissions are all men of outstanding talent who fulfill their duties and can concurrently handle grain revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shirong said that those appointed to Surveillance Commissions are all men of outstanding talent who fulfill their duties and can concurrently handle grain revenue.

sentences.zh: 而廷臣皆以為不可，彼所取人，臣不敢止，惟言行臺不可罷者，衆議皆然。」

translations.literal: Yet court ministers all held this impossible. As for the men he selects, your subject dares not obstruct; only on the matter of not abolishing the Branch Secretariat—all agree in deliberation.」
translations.idiomatic: Yet the court ministers all held this impossible. As for the men he selects, I dare not obstruct him; but on the point that the Branch Secretariat must not be abolished, all are of one mind."

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「世榮以為何如？」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「What does Shirong think?」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "What does Shirong think?"

sentences.zh: 奏曰：「欲罷之耳。」

translations.literal: The memorial replied: 「He wishes to abolish it, that is all.」
translations.idiomatic: The reply memorialized, "He wishes to abolish it, that is all."

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「其依世榮言。」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「Let it follow Shirong's words.」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "Then let it follow Shirong's recommendation."

sentences.zh: 中書省奏立規措所，秩五品，所司官吏，以善賈者為之。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat memorialized establishing a Planning Office, rank fifth grade, its officials to be men skilled in commerce.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat memorialized establishing a Planning Office of fifth rank, to be staffed by men skilled in commerce.

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「此何職？」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「What office is this?」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "What office is this?"

sentences.zh: 世榮對曰：「規畫錢穀者。」

translations.literal: Lu Shirong replied: 「Those who plan grain revenue.」
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shirong replied, "Those who plan grain revenue."

sentences.zh: 遂從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「天下能規運錢穀者，向日皆在阿合馬之門，今籍錄以為污濫，此豈可盡廢。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: 「Those throughout the realm able to plan and transport grain revenue were all formerly at Ahmad's door; now they are registered and deemed corrupt and unrestrained—how can they all be discarded?
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again, "Throughout the realm, those able to plan and transport grain revenue were all formerly in Ahmad's circle. Now they are registered and deemed corrupt and unrestrained—how can they all be discarded?

sentences.zh: 臣欲擇其通才可用者，然懼有言臣用罪人。」

translations.literal: Your subject wishes to select among them those of general talent who can be used, yet fears there will be talk that your subject employs criminals.」
translations.idiomatic: I wish to select among them those of general talent who can still be used, yet I fear there will be talk that I employ criminals."

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「何必言此，可用者用之。」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「Why speak of this—use those who can be used.」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "Why speak of that? Use those who can be used."

sentences.zh: 遂以前河間轉運使張弘綱、撒都丁、不魯合散、孫桓，並為河間、山東等路都轉運鹽使。

translations.literal: Thereupon the former Hejian Transport Commissioner Zhang Honggang, Sadudin, Buluheisan, and Sun Huan were all appointed Chief Transport Salt Commissioners for the Hejian, Shandong, and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the former Hejian transport commissioner Zhang Honggang, Sadudin, Buluheisan, and Sun Huan were all appointed chief transport salt commissioners for the Hejian, Shandong, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 其他擢用者甚衆。

translations.literal: Many others were also selected and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Many others were also promoted and employed.

sentences.zh: 世榮既以利自任，懼怒之者衆，乃以九事說世祖詔天下：其一，免民間包銀三年；

translations.literal: Lu Shirong, having made profit his personal charge, feared that many were enraged, and so persuaded Kublai with nine measures to proclaim to the realm: First, exempt the people from bundled silver for three years;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shirong, having made profit his personal mission, feared that many were enraged against him, and so persuaded Kublai to proclaim nine measures to the realm: first, exempt the people from bundled silver for three years;

sentences.zh: 其二，官吏俸免民間帶納；

translations.literal: Second, exempt the people from supplementary payments for officials' salaries;
translations.idiomatic: second, exempt the people from supplementary payments for officials' salaries;

sentences.zh: 其三，免大都地稅；

translations.literal: Third, exempt land tax in the Great Capital;
translations.idiomatic: third, exempt land tax in the Great Capital;

sentences.zh: 其四，江淮民失業貧困、鬻妻子以自給者，所在官為收贖，使為良民；

translations.literal: Fourth, among the people of Jiang and Huai who lost their livelihoods and grew impoverished, selling wives and children to support themselves—local officials should redeem them and restore them as upright commoners;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, among the people of Jiang and Huai who lost their livelihoods and grew impoverished, selling wives and children to support themselves—local officials should redeem them and restore them as upright commoners;

sentences.zh: 其五，逃移復業者，免其差稅；

translations.literal: Fifth, those who fled and then returned to their occupation are exempt from corvée levies and taxes;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, those who fled and then returned to their occupations are exempt from corvée levies and taxes;

sentences.zh: 其六，鄉民造醋者，免收課；

translations.literal: Sixth, village people who make vinegar are exempt from levies;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, village people who make vinegar are exempt from levies;

sentences.zh: 其七，江南田主收佃客租課，減免一分；

translations.literal: Seventh, landlords in Jiangnan collecting tenant rent and levies receive a one-tenth reduction;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, landlords in Jiangnan collecting tenant rent and levies receive a one-tenth reduction;

sentences.zh: 其八，添支內外官吏俸五分；

translations.literal: Eighth, increase salaries of internal and external officials by one-fifth;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, increase salaries of internal and external officials by one-fifth;

sentences.zh: 其九，定百官考課升擢之法。

translations.literal: Ninth, establish methods for assessing and promoting the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: ninth, establish methods for assessing and promoting the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 大抵欲以釋怨要譽而已，世祖悉從之。

translations.literal: In general he wished only to dispel resentment and win reputation; Kublai approved all.
translations.idiomatic: In general he wished only to dispel resentment and win reputation; Kublai approved them all.

sentences.zh: 既而又奏：「立真定、濟南、江淮等處宣慰司兼都轉運使司，以治課程，仍立條例，禁諸司不得追攝管課官吏，及遣人輒至辦課處沮擾，按察司不得檢察文卷。」

translations.literal: Thereafter he again memorialized: 「Establish Pacification Commissions concurrently serving as Chief Transport Offices at Zhending, Jinan, Jiang-Huai, and other places to administer revenue quotas; also establish regulations forbidding all offices from summoning and detaining revenue officials, and from sending men at will to revenue offices to obstruct and harass; Surveillance Commissions may not inspect documents.」
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he memorialized again, "Establish Pacification Commissions concurrently serving as Chief Transport Offices at Zhending, Jinan, Jiang-Huai, and other places to administer revenue quotas. Also establish regulations forbidding all offices from summoning and detaining revenue officials, or from sending men at will to revenue offices to obstruct and harass them. Surveillance Commissions may not inspect the documents."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「大都酒課，日用米千石，以天下之衆比京師，當居三分之二，酒課亦當日用米二千石。

translations.literal: He again memorialized: 「Wine revenue in the Great Capital consumes a thousand shi of grain daily. Comparing the population of the realm to the capital, they should account for two-thirds; wine revenue should likewise consume two thousand shi of grain daily.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again, "Wine revenue in the Great Capital consumes a thousand shi of grain daily. Comparing the population of the realm to the capital, they should account for two-thirds; wine revenue should likewise consume two thousand shi of grain daily.

sentences.zh: 今各路但緫計日用米三百六十石而已，其奸欺盜隱如此，安可不禁。

translations.literal: Now all circuits total only three hundred sixty shi of grain consumed daily—such is the fraud, deception, theft, and concealment; how can it not be forbidden?
translations.idiomatic: Yet all circuits together report only three hundred sixty shi of grain consumed daily. Such is the scale of fraud, deception, theft, and concealment—how can it not be forbidden?

sentences.zh: 臣等已責各官增舊課二十倍，後有不如數者，重其罪。」

translations.literal: Your subjects have already charged each official to increase the old levy twentyfold; afterward those who fail to meet the quota will be punished severely.」
translations.idiomatic: We have already charged each official to increase the old levy twentyfold; afterward those who fail to meet the quota will be punished severely."

sentences.zh: 皆從之。

translations.literal: All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，世榮奏以宣德、王好禮並為浙西道宣慰使。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengzi, Lu Shirong memorialized appointing Xude and Wang Haoli both as Pacification Commissioners of the Zhexi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day gengzi, Lu Shirong memorialized appointing Xude and Wang Haoli both as pacification commissioners of the Zhexi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「宣德，人多言其惡。」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「Many say Xude is wicked.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "Many say Xude is wicked."

sentences.zh: 世榮奏：「彼入狀中書，能歲辦鈔七十五萬錠，是以令往。」

translations.literal: Lu Shirong memorialized: 「He submitted a petition to the Central Secretariat pledging to deliver seven hundred fifty thousand ingots of paper currency annually—that is why he was sent.」
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shirong memorialized, "He submitted a petition to the Central Secretariat pledging to deliver seven hundred fifty thousand ingots of paper currency annually—that is why he was sent."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The appointment was approved.

sentences.zh: 四月，世榮奏曰：「臣伏蒙聖眷，事皆委臣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Lu Shirong memorialized: 「Your subject humbly receives Your Majesty's favor; all affairs are entrusted to your subject.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Lu Shirong memorialized, "Your subject humbly receives Your Majesty's favor; all affairs are entrusted to me.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為今日之事，如數萬頃田，昔無田之者，草生其間。

translations.literal: Your subject foolishly considers today's affairs like tens of thousands of acres of field—formerly no one tilled them, and grass grew among them.
translations.idiomatic: I foolishly consider today's affairs like tens of thousands of acres of field—formerly no one tilled them, and grass grew among them.

sentences.zh: 臣今創田之，已耕者有焉，未耕者有焉，或纔播種，或既生苗，然不令人守之，為物蹂踐，則可惜也。

translations.literal: Your subject now opens them to cultivation; some are already plowed, some not yet; some have just been sown, some already have sprouts—yet if no one is set to guard them and beasts trample them, it would be a pity.
translations.idiomatic: I am now opening them to cultivation. Some are already plowed, some not yet; some have just been sown, some already have sprouts. Yet if no one is set to guard them and beasts trample them, it would be a pity.

sentences.zh: 方今丞相安童，督臣所行，是守田者也。

translations.literal: At present Chancellor An Tong supervises what your subject carries out—he is the one guarding the field.
translations.idiomatic: At present Chancellor An Tong supervises what I carry out—he is the one guarding the field.

sentences.zh: 然不假之以力，則田者亦徒勞耳。

translations.literal: Yet if he is not given power, the tiller labors in vain.
translations.idiomatic: Yet if he is not given power, the tiller labors in vain.

sentences.zh: 守田者假之力矣，而天不雨，則亦終無成，所謂天雨者，陛下與臣添力是也。

translations.literal: The field-guard has been given power, but if heaven does not rain, in the end nothing succeeds; what is called heaven's rain is Your Majesty and your subject adding strength.
translations.idiomatic: The field-guard has been given power, but if heaven does not rain, in the end nothing succeeds. What is called heaven's rain is Your Majesty and I adding strength together.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下憐臣。」

translations.literal: Only may Your Majesty pity your subject.」
translations.idiomatic: Only may Your Majesty pity me."

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「朕知之矣。」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「I understand.」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "I understand."

sentences.zh: 令奏行事之目，皆從之。

translations.literal: He ordered the items for carrying out affairs to be memorialized; all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the items for carrying out affairs to be memorialized; all were approved.

sentences.zh: 世榮居中書纔數月，恃委任之專，肆無忌憚，視丞相猶虛位也。

translations.literal: Lu Shirong had been in the Central Secretariat only a few months, relying on exclusive trust, acting without restraint and without fear, treating the chancellor as though the post were vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shirong had been in the Central Secretariat only a few months. Relying on exclusive trust, he acted without restraint or fear and treated the chancellor as though the post were vacant.

sentences.zh: 左司郎中周戭與世榮稍不合，坐以廢格詔旨，奏而殺之，朝中凜凜。

translations.literal: Left Department Director Zhou Yan slightly disagreed with Lu Shirong; on the charge of obstructing an edict, a memorial was submitted and Zhou Yan was executed—the court was gripped with fear.
translations.idiomatic: Left Department Director Zhou Yan slightly disagreed with Lu Shirong. On the charge of obstructing an edict, a memorial was submitted and Zhou Yan was executed—the court was gripped with fear.

sentences.zh: 監察御史陳天祥上章劾之，大概言其「苛刻誅求，為國斂怨，將見民間凋耗，天下空虛。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Chen Tianxiang submitted a memorial impeaching him, in general saying he was 「harsh and exacting in demands, amassing resentment for the state; soon the people will be depleted and the realm emptied.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Chen Tianxiang submitted a memorial impeaching him, saying in general that he was "harsh and exacting in his demands, amassing resentment for the state; soon the people will be depleted and the realm emptied.

sentences.zh: 考其所行與所言者，已不相副：始言能令鈔法如舊，弊今愈甚；

translations.literal: Examining his deeds against his words, they already do not match: at first he said he could restore the paper currency system as before—the debasement is now worse;
translations.idiomatic: Examining his deeds against his words, they already do not match: at first he said he could restore the paper currency system as before—yet the debasement is now worse;

sentences.zh: 始言能令百物自賤，今百物愈貴；

translations.literal: at first he said he could make all goods cheap by themselves—now all goods grow dearer;
translations.idiomatic: at first he said he could make all goods cheap of themselves—now all goods grow dearer;

sentences.zh: 始言課程增至三百萬錠，不取於民，今迫脅諸路，勒令如數虛認而已；

translations.literal: at first he said revenue quotas could be raised to three million ingots without taking from the people—now he coerces all circuits and forces them only to falsely report the numbers;
translations.idiomatic: at first he said revenue quotas could be raised to three million ingots without taking from the people—now he coerces all circuits and forces them only to falsely report the numbers;

sentences.zh: 始言令民快樂，今所為無非擾民之事。

translations.literal: at first he said he would make the people happy—now everything he does is nothing but trouble for the people.
translations.idiomatic: at first he said he would make the people happy—now everything he does is nothing but trouble for the people.

sentences.zh: 若不早為更張，待其自敗，正猶蠹雖除而木已病矣」。

translations.literal: If reform is not undertaken early, waiting for him to fail on his own, it is just like removing a borer while the tree is already diseased」.
translations.idiomatic: If reform is not undertaken early, waiting for him to fail on his own, it is just like removing a borer while the tree is already diseased."

sentences.zh: 世祖時在上都，御中大夫玉速帖木兒以其狀聞，世祖始大悟，即日遣唆都八都兒、禿剌帖木兒等還大都。

translations.literal: Kublai was then at Shangdu; Attending Grand Master Yusutemür reported the memorial, and Kublai at last understood fully; that same day he dispatched Sodubadu'er, Tulatetemür, and others back to the Great Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai was then at Shangdu. Attending Grand Master Yusutemür reported Chen's memorial, and Kublai at last understood fully. That same day he dispatched Sodubadu'er, Tulatetemür, and others back to the Great Capital.

sentences.zh: 命安童集諸司官吏、老臣、儒士，及知民間事者，同世榮聽天祥彈文，仍令世榮、天祥同赴上都。

translations.literal: He ordered An Tong to assemble officials of all offices, senior ministers, Confucian scholars, and those who knew conditions among the people, together with Lu Shirong to hear Chen Tianxiang's impeachment memorial, and also ordered Lu Shirong and Chen Tianxiang to proceed together to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered An Tong to assemble officials of all offices, senior ministers, Confucian scholars, and those who knew conditions among the people, together with Lu Shirong to hear Chen Tianxiang's impeachment memorial. He also ordered Lu Shirong and Chen Tianxiang to proceed together to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，御史中丞阿剌帖木兒、郭佑，侍御史白禿剌帖木兒，參政撒的迷失等，以世榮所伏罪狀奏曰：「不白丞相安童，支鈔二十萬錠。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Censor-in-Chief Alatetemür and Guo You, Attending Censor Bai Tulatetemür, Administration Commissioner Sadiemishi, and others reported Lu Shirong's admitted crimes: 「Without informing Chancellor An Tong, he disbursed two hundred thousand ingots of paper currency.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, Censor-in-Chief Alatetemür and Guo You, Attending Censor Bai Tulatetemür, Administration Commissioner Sadiemishi, and others reported Lu Shirong's admitted crimes: "Without informing Chancellor An Tong, he disbursed two hundred thousand ingots of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 擅升六部為二品。

translations.literal: He on his own authority raised the Six Ministries to second rank.
translations.idiomatic: He on his own authority raised the Six Ministries to second rank.

sentences.zh: 效李璮令急遞鋪用紅青白三色囊轉行文字。

translations.literal: Imitating Li Tan, he ordered express courier stations to use red, green, and white pouches to transmit documents.
translations.idiomatic: Imitating Li Tan, he ordered express courier stations to use red, green, and white pouches to transmit documents.

sentences.zh: 不與樞密院議，調三行省萬二千人置濟州，委漕運使陳柔為萬戶管領。

translations.literal: Without consulting the Bureau of Military Affairs, he transferred twelve thousand men from three branch secretariats and stationed them at Jizhou, entrusting Grain Transport Commissioner Chen Rou as myriarch to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Without consulting the Bureau of Military Affairs, he transferred twelve thousand men from three branch secretariats and stationed them at Jizhou, entrusting grain transport commissioner Chen Rou as myriarch to command them.

sentences.zh: 以沙全代萬戶寗玉戍浙西吳江。

translations.literal: He replaced Myriarch Ning Yu with Sha Quan to garrison Wujiang in western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: He replaced Myriarch Ning Yu with Sha Quan to garrison Wujiang in western Zhe.

sentences.zh: 用阿合馬黨人潘傑、馮珪為杭、鄂二行省參政，宣德為杭州宣慰，餘分布中外者衆。

translations.literal: He employed Ahmad's faction members Pan Jie and Feng Gui as administration commissioners of the Hang and E Branch Secretariats, Xude as Hangzhou Pacification Commissioner—many others were distributed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: He employed Ahmad's faction members Pan Jie and Feng Gui as administration commissioners of the Hang and E Branch Secretariats, and Xude as Hangzhou pacification commissioner—many others were distributed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以鈔虛，閉回易庫，民間昏鈔不可行。

translations.literal: Because paper currency was hollow, he closed the exchange treasury; worn paper currency among the people could not circulate.
translations.idiomatic: Because paper currency had grown hollow, he closed the exchange treasury, and worn paper currency among the people could not circulate.

sentences.zh: 罷白酵課。

translations.literal: He abolished the white yeast levy.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished the white yeast levy.

sentences.zh: 立野麵、木植、磁器、桑棗、煤炭、匹段、青果、油坊諸牙行。

translations.literal: He established brokerages for wild flour, timber, porcelain, mulberry and jujube, coal, bolts of cloth, green fruit, and oil mills.
translations.idiomatic: He established brokerages for wild flour, timber, porcelain, mulberry and jujube, coal, bolts of cloth, green fruit, and oil mills.

sentences.zh: 調出縣官鈔八十六萬餘錠。」

translations.literal: He transferred out more than eight hundred sixty thousand ingots of government paper currency.」
translations.idiomatic: He transferred out more than eight hundred sixty thousand ingots of government paper currency."

sentences.zh: 丞相安童言：「世榮昔奏，能不取於民歲辦鈔三百萬錠，令鈔復實，諸物悉賤，民得休息，數月即有成效。

translations.literal: Chancellor An Tong said: 「Lu Shirong formerly memorialized that without taking from the people he could annually deliver three million ingots, restore paper currency to solidity, make all goods cheap, let the people rest—within months there would be results.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor An Tong said, "Lu Shirong formerly memorialized that without taking from the people he could annually deliver three million ingots, restore paper currency to solidity, make all goods cheap, and let the people rest—within months there would be results.

sentences.zh: 今已四閱月，所行不符所言，錢穀出者多於所入，引用憸人，紊亂選法。」

translations.literal: Four months have already passed; what has been done does not match what was said. Revenue disbursements exceed receipts. He employs crafty men and disrupts the appointment system.」
translations.idiomatic: Four months have already passed, yet what has been done does not match what was said. Revenue disbursements exceed receipts. He employs crafty men and disrupts the appointment system."

sentences.zh: 翰林學士趙孟傳等，亦以為「世榮初以財賦自任，當時人情不敢預料，將謂別有方術，可以增益國用。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Zhao Mengchuan and others also held that 「when Lu Shirong first took fiscal revenue as his charge, public sentiment dared not anticipate; one would suppose he had some special method to increase state revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Zhao Mengchuan and others also held that "when Lu Shirong first took fiscal revenue as his charge, public sentiment dared not anticipate; one would suppose he had some special method to increase state revenue.

sentences.zh: 及今觀之，不過如御史所言。

translations.literal: Now observing it, it is no more than what the censor said.
translations.idiomatic: Now that we observe it, it is no more than what the censor said.

sentences.zh: 更張之機，正在今日。

translations.literal: The opportunity for reform is precisely today.
translations.idiomatic: The opportunity for reform is precisely today.

sentences.zh: 若復恣其所行，為害非細」。

translations.literal: If he is again allowed to act as he pleases, the harm will not be slight」.
translations.idiomatic: If he is again allowed to act as he pleases, the harm will not be slight."

sentences.zh: 阿剌帖木兒同天祥等與世榮對於世祖前，一一款伏。

translations.literal: Alatetemür together with Chen Tianxiang and others faced Lu Shirong before Kublai, and item by item he admitted guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Alatetemür together with Chen Tianxiang and others faced Lu Shirong before Kublai, and item by item he confessed guilt.

sentences.zh: 遣忽都帶兒傳旨中書省，命丞相安童與諸老臣議，世榮所行，當罷者罷之，更者更之，所用人實無罪者，朕自裁處。

translations.literal: Kublai dispatched Hududai'er to convey an edict to the Central Secretariat, ordering Chancellor An Tong to deliberate with senior ministers on what Lu Shirong had done—what should be abolished was to be abolished, what should be changed was to be changed; as for appointees who were truly without guilt, I myself will decide.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai dispatched Hududai'er to convey an edict to the Central Secretariat, ordering Chancellor An Tong to deliberate with senior ministers on what Lu Shirong had done—what should be abolished was to be abolished, what should be changed was to be changed. As for appointees who were truly without guilt, he said, "I myself will decide."

sentences.zh: 遂下世榮于獄。

translations.literal: Lu Shirong was then imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shirong was then imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，世祖問忽剌出曰：「汝於盧世榮有何言？」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yiwei, Kublai asked Hulachu: 「What do you have to say regarding Lu Shirong?」
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day yiwei, Kublai asked Hulachu, "What do you have to say regarding Lu Shirong?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「近漢人新居中書者，言世榮款伏，罪無遺者，獄已竟矣，猶日養之，徒費廩食。」

translations.literal: He replied: 「Recently a Han Chinese newly placed in the Central Secretariat said Shirong has fully confessed, leaving no crime unadmitted—the trial is already complete, yet he is still fed daily, wasting grain from the public stores.」
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Recently a Han Chinese newly placed in the Central Secretariat said Shirong has fully confessed, leaving no crime unadmitted—the trial is already complete, yet he is still fed daily, wasting grain from the public stores."

sentences.zh: 有旨誅世榮，刲其肉以食禽獺。

translations.literal: An edict was issued to execute Lu Shirong; his flesh was carved and fed to birds and otters.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued to execute Lu Shirong. His flesh was carved and fed to birds and otters.

sentences.zh: 桑哥，膽巴國師之弟子也。

translations.literal: Sangge was a disciple of National Preceptor Danba.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge was a disciple of National Preceptor Danba.

sentences.zh: 能通諸國言語，故嘗為西蕃譯史。

translations.literal: Able to speak the languages of many states, he had formerly served as a Tibetan interpreter.
translations.idiomatic: Able to speak the languages of many states, he had formerly served as a Tibetan interpreter.

sentences.zh: 為人狡黠豪橫，好言財利事，世祖喜之。

translations.literal: As a man he was cunning, domineering, and fond of speaking of profit and revenue—Kublai was pleased with him.
translations.idiomatic: Cunning and domineering, he was fond of speaking of profit and revenue, and Kublai was pleased with him.

sentences.zh: 及後貴幸，乃諱言師事膽巴而背之。

translations.literal: When later ennobled and favored, he concealed that he had studied under Danba and turned against him.
translations.idiomatic: When later ennobled and favored, he concealed that he had studied under Danba and turned against him.

sentences.zh: 至元中，擢為緫制院使。

translations.literal: During the Zhiyuan era he was promoted to Commissioner of the General Regulation Office.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhiyuan era he was promoted to commissioner of the General Regulation Office.

sentences.zh: 緫制院者，掌浮圖氏之教，兼治吐蕃之事。

translations.literal: The General Regulation Office oversaw the Buddhist religion and also administered Tibetan affairs jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The General Regulation Office oversaw the Buddhist religion and also jointly administered Tibetan affairs.

sentences.zh: 御史臺嘗欲以章閭為按察使，世祖曰：「此人桑哥嘗言之。」

translations.literal: The Censorate once wished to appoint Zhang Lü as Surveillance Commissioner; Kublai said: 「This man Sangge once spoke of him.」
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate once wished to appoint Zhang Lü as surveillance commissioner. Kublai said, "Sangge once spoke of this man."

sentences.zh: 及盧世榮見用，亦由桑哥之薦。

translations.literal: When Lu Shirong was employed, it too was through Sangge's recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu Shirong was employed, it too was through Sangge's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 中書省嘗令李留判者市油，桑哥自請得其錢市之，司徒和禮霍孫謂非汝所宜為，桑哥不服，至與相毆，且謂之曰：「與其使漢人侵盜，曷若與僧寺及官府營利息乎？」

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat once ordered Controller Li to purchase oil; Sangge volunteered to take the funds and make the purchase. Minister of Education Horchi said this was not suitable for him to do; Sangge would not accept it and even came to blows with him, saying: 「Rather than letting Han Chinese encroach and steal, is it not better to let monasteries and government offices earn interest?」
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat once ordered Controller Li to purchase oil. Sangge volunteered to take the funds and make the purchase. Minister of Education Horchi said this was not suitable for him to do. Sangge would not accept it and even came to blows with him, saying, "Rather than letting Han Chinese encroach and steal, is it not better to let monasteries and government offices earn interest?"

sentences.zh: 乃以油萬斤與之。

translations.literal: Ten thousand jin of oil were given to him.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand jin of oil were given to him.

sentences.zh: 桑哥後以所營息錢進，和禮霍孫曰：「我初不悟此也。」

translations.literal: Sangge later presented the interest money he had earned; Horchi said: 「At first I did not understand this.」
translations.idiomatic: Sangge later presented the interest money he had earned. Horchi said, "At first I did not understand this."

sentences.zh: 一日，桑哥在世祖前論和雇和買事，因語及此，世祖益喜，始有大任之意。

translations.literal: One day Sangge discussed hired labor and government purchase before Kublai; bringing up this matter as well, Kublai was further pleased and first conceived the intention of great appointment.
translations.idiomatic: One day Sangge discussed hired labor and government purchase before Kublai. Bringing up this matter as well, Kublai was further pleased and first conceived the intention of granting him great appointment.

sentences.zh: 嘗有旨令桑哥具省臣姓名以進，廷中有所建置，人才進退，桑哥咸與聞焉。

translations.literal: An edict once ordered Sangge to compile the names of secretariat ministers and submit them; whenever the court established anything or advanced or dismissed talent, Sangge was informed of all.
translations.idiomatic: An edict once ordered Sangge to compile the names of secretariat ministers and submit them. Whenever the court established anything or advanced or dismissed talent, Sangge was informed of all.

sentences.zh: 二十四年閏二月，復置尚書省，遂以桑哥與鐵木兒為平章政事。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month of the twenty-fourth year, the Imperial Secretariat was reestablished; Sangge and Temür were then made Grand Councillors of State.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of the twenty-fourth year, the Imperial Secretariat was reestablished, and Sangge and Temür were appointed grand councillors of state.

sentences.zh: 詔告天下，改行中書省為行尚書省，六部為尚書六部。

translations.literal: An edict announced to the empire, changing the regional Central Secretariat to the regional Imperial Secretariat, and the six ministries to the six ministries of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued throughout the empire, redesignating the regional Central Secretariat as the regional Imperial Secretariat and the six ministries as the six ministries of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月，更定鈔法，頒行至元寶鈔於天下，中統鈔通行如故。

translations.literal: In the third month, the paper currency regulations were revised; Zhiyuan treasure notes were issued throughout the empire, and Zhongtong notes continued to circulate as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the paper currency regulations were revised. Zhiyuan treasure notes were issued throughout the empire, while Zhongtong notes continued to circulate as before.

sentences.zh: 桑哥嘗奉旨檢覈中書省事，凡校出虧欠鈔四千七百七十錠、昏鈔一千三百四十五錠，平章麥朮丁即自伏，參政楊居寬微自辯，以為實掌銓選，錢穀非所專。

translations.literal: Sangge had once received an imperial order to audit Central Secretariat affairs; in all they verified 4,770 ingots of missing notes and 1,345 ingots of worn notes. Grand Councillor Makhtudan immediately confessed on his own; Vice Grand Councillor Yang Jukuan offered a slight self-defense, saying he actually managed personnel selection and that finance and grain were not his specialty.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge had once received an imperial order to audit Central Secretariat affairs. The audit turned up 4,770 ingots of missing notes and 1,345 ingots of worn notes. Grand Councillor Makhtudan immediately confessed. Vice Grand Councillor Yang Jukuan offered a mild defense, saying that he actually managed personnel selection and that finance and grain were not his specialty.

sentences.zh: 桑哥令左右拳其面，因問曰：「既典選事，果無黜陟失當者乎？」

translations.literal: Sangge ordered his attendants to punch him in the face, then asked: 「Since you manage selection affairs, were there really no appointments and dismissals that were improper?」
translations.idiomatic: Sangge ordered his attendants to punch him in the face, then asked, "Since you manage selection affairs, were there really no appointments and dismissals that were improper?"

sentences.zh: 尋亦引服。

translations.literal: Soon he too confessed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he too confessed.

sentences.zh: 參議伯降以下，凡鉤考違惰耗失等事，及參議王巨濟嘗言新鈔不便忤旨，各款伏。

translations.literal: Below Associate Legislative Supervisor Bo Jiang, all matters of audit investigation for violations, negligence, waste, and loss, as well as Associate Legislative Supervisor Wang Juji, who had once said the new notes were inconvenient and offended the imperial will—all confessed in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Below Associate Legislative Supervisor Bo Jiang, everyone involved in the audit investigation for violations, negligence, waste, and loss confessed in detail, as did Associate Legislative Supervisor Wang Juji, who had once said the new notes were inconvenient and thereby offended the imperial will.

sentences.zh: 遣參政忻都奏聞，世祖令丞相安童與桑哥共議，且諭：「毋令麥朮丁等他日得以脅問誣伏為辭，此輩固狡獪人也。」

translations.literal: He dispatched Vice Grand Councillor Xindu to report to the throne. Kublai ordered Chancellor An Tong to deliberate jointly with Sangge, and also instructed: 「Do not let Makhtudan and the others someday use coerced interrogation and false confession as a pretext—they are inherently cunning people.」
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Vice Grand Councillor Xindu to report to the throne. Kublai ordered Chancellor An Tong to deliberate jointly with Sangge and also instructed, "Do not let Makhtudan and the others someday use coerced interrogation and false confession as a pretext—they are inherently cunning people."

sentences.zh: 數日，桑哥又奏：「鞫中書參政郭佑，多所逋負，尸位不言，以疾為託。

translations.literal: Several days later, Sangge again memorialized: 「Interrogating Central Secretariat Vice Grand Councillor Guo You, there were many arrears; he occupied his post without speaking, using illness as a pretense.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later, Sangge again memorialized, "In interrogating Central Secretariat Vice Grand Councillor Guo You, I found many arrears. He occupied his post without speaking and used illness as a pretense.

sentences.zh: 臣謂中書之務，隳惰如此，汝力不能及，何不告之蒙古大臣，故毆辱之，今已款服。」

translations.literal: I say the Central Secretariat's affairs are this negligent and idle—as you were unable to cope, why did you not report it to the Mongol ministers? Therefore I beat and humiliated him; now he has fully confessed.」
translations.idiomatic: I say the Central Secretariat's affairs have fallen into such negligence and idleness. As you were unable to cope, why did you not report it to the Mongol ministers? Therefore I beat and humiliated him, and now he has fully confessed."

sentences.zh: 世祖命窮詰之。

translations.literal: Kublai ordered a thorough interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai ordered a thorough interrogation.

sentences.zh: 佑與居寬後皆棄市，人咸冤焉。

translations.literal: You and Jukuan were ultimately both executed at the market; people all considered it an injustice.
translations.idiomatic: You and Jukuan were ultimately both executed at the market, and people everywhere considered it an injustice.

sentences.zh: 臺吏王良弼，嘗與人議尚書省政事，又言：「尚書鉤校中書，不遺餘力，他日我曹得發尚書奸利，其誅籍無難。」

translations.literal: Censorate clerk Wang Liangbi once discussed Imperial Secretariat affairs with others, and also said: 「The Imperial Secretariat's audit of the Central Secretariat leaves no effort untried. Someday when we can expose the Imperial Secretariat's corruption and profit-seeking, their execution and confiscation of property will not be difficult.」
translations.idiomatic: Censorate clerk Wang Liangbi once discussed Imperial Secretariat affairs with others and also said, "The Imperial Secretariat's audit of the Central Secretariat leaves no effort untried. Someday, when we can expose the Imperial Secretariat's corruption and profit-seeking, their execution and confiscation of property will not be difficult."

sentences.zh: 桑哥聞之，捕良弼至，與中書臺院札魯忽赤鞫問，款服，謂此曹誹謗，不誅無以懲後。

translations.literal: Sangge heard of it, arrested Liangbi, and together with the Central Secretariat, Censorate, and Court darughachi interrogated him. He confessed fully. Sangge said these men were slandering; without execution there would be no way to warn posterity.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge heard of it, arrested Liangbi, and together with the Central Secretariat, Censorate, and Court darughachi interrogated him until he confessed fully. Sangge said these men were slandering and that without execution there would be no way to warn posterity.

sentences.zh: 遂誅良弼，籍其家。

translations.literal: So Liangbi was executed and his household property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: So Liangbi was executed and his household property was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 有吳德者，嘗為江寧縣達魯花赤，求仕不遂，私與人非議時政，又言：「尚書今日覈正中書之弊，他日復為中書所覈，汝獨不死也耶。」

translations.literal: There was one Wu De who had once served as darughachi of Jiangning County. Unable to obtain an appointment, he privately criticized current policy with others, and also said: 「The Imperial Secretariat today is auditing and correcting the Central Secretariat's abuses. Someday it will in turn be audited by the Central Secretariat. Will you alone not die?」
translations.idiomatic: There was a man named Wu De who had once served as darughachi of Jiangning County. Unable to obtain an appointment, he privately criticized current policy with others and also said, "The Imperial Secretariat today is auditing and correcting the Central Secretariat's abuses. Someday it will in turn be audited by the Central Secretariat. Will you alone not die?"

sentences.zh: 或以告桑哥，亟捕德按問，殺之，沒其妻子入官。

translations.literal: Someone reported this to Sangge. He immediately arrested De for investigation, killed him, and confiscated his wife and children into government service.
translations.idiomatic: Someone reported this to Sangge. He immediately arrested De for investigation, killed him, and confiscated his wife and children into government service.

sentences.zh: 桑哥嘗奏以沙不丁遙授江淮行省左丞，烏馬兒為參政，依前領泉府、市舶兩司，拜降福建行省平章。

translations.literal: Sangge once memorialized to appoint Sabuding remotely as Left Vice Commissioner of the Jianghuai Regional Secretariat, Umar as Vice Grand Councillor, continuing as before to head the Quanfu and Maritime Trade bureaus, and Bai Jiang as Grand Councillor of the Fujian Regional Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge once memorialized to appoint Sabuding remotely as left vice commissioner of the Jianghuai Regional Secretariat, Umar as vice grand councillor while continuing as before to head the Quanfu and Maritime Trade bureaus, and Bai Jiang as grand councillor of the Fujian Regional Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 既得旨，乃言於世祖曰：「臣前言，凡任省臣與行省官，並與丞相安童共議。

translations.literal: After receiving approval, he then said to Kublai: 「Your subject previously stated that whenever appointing secretariat ministers and regional secretariat officials, all should be jointly deliberated with Chancellor An Tong.
translations.idiomatic: After receiving approval, he then said to Kublai, "Your subject previously stated that whenever appointing secretariat ministers and regional secretariat officials, all should be jointly deliberated with Chancellor An Tong.

sentences.zh: 今奏用沙不丁、烏馬兒等，適丞相還大都，不及通議，臣恐有以前奏為言者。」

translations.literal: Now in memorializing the appointment of Sabuding, Umar, and the others, it happened that the Chancellor had returned to Dadu and there was no time for joint consultation. Your subject fears there may be those who speak on the basis of the earlier memorial.」
translations.idiomatic: Now, in memorializing the appointment of Sabuding, Umar, and the others, it happened that the chancellor had returned to Dadu and there was no time for joint consultation. Your subject fears there may be those who speak on the basis of the earlier memorial."

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「安童不在，朕，若主也。

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「An Tong is not here; I am, as it were, the host.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "An Tong is not here. I am, as it were, the host.

sentences.zh: 朕已允行，有言者，其令朕前言之。」

translations.literal: I have already approved it. If there are those who wish to speak, let them speak before me.」
translations.idiomatic: I have already approved it. If anyone wishes to speak, let him speak before me."

sentences.zh: 時江南行臺與行省，並無文移，事無巨細，必咨內臺呈省聞奏。

translations.literal: At that time the Jiangnan Regional Censorate and the regional secretariat had no written communications between them; matters great and small all had to be referred to the Metropolitan Censorate, presented to the secretariat, reported, and memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Jiangnan Regional Censorate and the regional secretariat had no written communications between them. Matters great and small all had to be referred to the Metropolitan Censorate, presented to the secretariat, reported, and memorialized.

sentences.zh: 桑哥以其往復稽留誤事，宜如內臺例，分呈各省。

translations.literal: Sangge held that because the back-and-forth caused delays and impeded business, it should follow the Metropolitan Censorate precedent and be separately presented to each province.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge held that because the back-and-forth caused delays and impeded business, it should follow the Metropolitan Censorate precedent and be separately presented to each province.

sentences.zh: 又言：「按察司文案，宜從各路民官檢覈，遞相糾舉。

translations.literal: He also said: 「Surveillance Commission documents should be audited by the civil officials of each route, with mutual reporting and impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Surveillance Commission documents should be audited by the civil officials of each route, with mutual reporting and impeachment.

sentences.zh: 且自太祖時有旨，凡臨官事者互相覺察，此故事也。」

translations.literal: Moreover, since the time of Taizu there has been an edict that all who hold office should mutually oversee one another—this is established precedent.」
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, since the time of Taizu there has been an edict that all who hold office should mutually oversee one another. This is established precedent."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: It was approved.

sentences.zh: 十月乙酉，世祖遣諭旨翰林諸臣：「以丞相領尚書省，漢、唐有此制否？」

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the tenth month, Kublai sent an instruction to the Hanlin academicians: 「Did Han and Tang have the institution of a Chancellor heading the Imperial Secretariat?」
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the tenth month, Kublai sent an instruction to the Hanlin academicians: "Did Han and Tang have the institution of a chancellor heading the Imperial Secretariat?"

sentences.zh: 咸對曰：「有之。」

translations.literal: All replied: 「There was.」
translations.idiomatic: All replied, "There was."

sentences.zh: 翌日，左丞葉李以翰林、集賢諸臣所對奏之，且言：「前省官不能行者，平章桑哥能之，宜為右丞相。」

translations.literal: The next day, Left Vice Commissioner Ye Li memorialized the replies of the Hanlin and Academia Sinica academicians, and also said: 「What the former secretariat officials could not accomplish, Grand Councillor Sangge can accomplish; he should be made Right Chancellor.」
translations.idiomatic: The next day, Left Vice Commissioner Ye Li memorialized the replies of the Hanlin and Academia Sinica academicians and also said, "What the former secretariat officials could not accomplish, Grand Councillor Sangge can accomplish. He should be made right chancellor."

sentences.zh: 制曰「可」。

translations.literal: An edict said 「Approved.」
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 遂以桑哥為尚書右丞相，兼緫制院使，領功德使司事，進階金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Sangge was then made Right Chancellor of the Imperial Secretariat, concurrently Commissioner of the General Regulation Bureau, heading the Bureau of Meritorious Deeds, and advanced in rank to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge was then made right chancellor of the Imperial Secretariat, concurrently commissioner of the General Regulation Bureau and head of the Bureau of Meritorious Deeds, and was advanced in rank to Grand Master for Glorious Happiness with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 於是桑哥奏以平章鐵木兒代其位，右丞阿剌渾撒里陞平章政事，葉李遷右丞，參政馬紹陞左丞。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sangge memorialized that Grand Councillor Temür replace him in his former post; Right Vice Commissioner Alqun Sali was promoted to Grand Councillor of State; Ye Li was transferred to Right Vice Commissioner; and Vice Grand Councillor Ma Shao was promoted to Left Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Sangge memorialized that Grand Councillor Temür replace him in his former post. Right Vice Commissioner Alqun Sali was promoted to grand councillor of state, Ye Li was transferred to right vice commissioner, and Vice Grand Councillor Ma Shao was promoted to left vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月，桑哥言：「臣前以諸道宣慰司及路府州縣官吏，稽緩誤事，奉旨遣人遍笞責之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Sangge said: 「Your subject previously, because the officials of the various circuit pacification commissions and of routes, prefectures, districts, and counties were dilatory and impeded business, received an imperial order to dispatch men to beat and reprimand them throughout.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Sangge said, "Your subject previously, because the officials of the various circuit pacification commissions and of routes, prefectures, districts, and counties were dilatory and impeded business, received an imperial order to dispatch men to beat and reprimand them throughout.

sentences.zh: 今真定宣慰使速哥、南京宣慰使荅失蠻，皆勳賢舊臣之子，宜取聖裁。」

translations.literal: Now Pacification Commissioner Suge of Zhending and Pacification Commissioner Dashiman of Nanjing are both sons of meritorious and worthy old ministers; the sacred decision should be sought.」
translations.idiomatic: Now Pacification Commissioner Suge of Zhending and Pacification Commissioner Dashiman of Nanjing are both sons of meritorious and worthy old ministers. The sacred decision should be sought."

sentences.zh: 敕罷其任。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed them from office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dismissed them from office.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，以甘肅行尚書省參政鐵木哥無心任事，又不與協力，奏乞牙帶代之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, because Vice Grand Councillor Temüge of the Gansu Regional Imperial Secretariat had no heart for office and would not cooperate, Sangge memorialized requesting that Yada replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, because Vice Grand Councillor Temüge of the Gansu Regional Imperial Secretariat had no heart for office and would not cooperate, Sangge memorialized requesting that Yada replace him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，又以江西行尚書省平章政事忽都鐵木兒不職，奏而罷之。

translations.literal: Before long, he also memorialized and had dismissed Grand Councillor Qud Temür of the Jiangxi Regional Imperial Secretariat for dereliction of duty.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, he also memorialized and had dismissed Grand Councillor Qud Temür of the Jiangxi Regional Imperial Secretariat for dereliction of duty.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書忽都荅兒不勤其職，桑哥毆罷之而後奏，世祖曰：「若此等不罷，汝事何由得行也。」

translations.literal: Minister of War Qudar was not diligent in his duties. Sangge beat him and removed him, then reported it. Kublai said: 「If men like this are not removed, how can your affairs be carried out?」
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Qudar was not diligent in his duties. Sangge beat him and removed him, then reported it. Kublai said, "If men like this are not removed, how can your affairs be carried out?"

sentences.zh: 萬億庫有舊牌絛七千餘條，桑哥言歲久則腐，宜析而他用。

translations.literal: The Ten-Thousand-Million Treasury had more than 7,000 old tally cords. Sangge said that after many years they would rot and should be split up for other uses.
translations.idiomatic: The Ten-Thousand-Million Treasury had more than 7,000 old tally cords. Sangge said that after many years they would rot and should be split up for other uses.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王出伯銀二萬五千兩、幣帛萬匹，載以官驢，至則併以為賜。

translations.literal: Prince Chubai was granted 25,000 taels of silver and 10,000 bolts of silk and brocade, to be loaded on government donkeys and presented together upon arrival.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chubai was granted 25,000 taels of silver and 10,000 bolts of silk and brocade, to be loaded on government donkeys and presented together upon arrival.

sentences.zh: 桑哥言：「不若以驢載玉而回。」

translations.literal: Sangge said: 「Would it not be better to load jade on the donkeys for the return trip?」
translations.idiomatic: Sangge said, "Would it not be better to load jade on the donkeys for the return trip?"

sentences.zh: 世祖甚然之。

translations.literal: Kublai greatly approved.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai greatly approved.

sentences.zh: 其欲以小利結知如此。

translations.literal: His desire to win favor through small profit was like this.
translations.idiomatic: Such was his desire to win favor through small profit.

sentences.zh: 漕運司達魯花赤怯來，未嘗巡察沿河諸倉，致盜詐腐敗者多，桑哥議以兵部侍郎塔察兒代之。

translations.literal: Qilai, darughachi of the Grain Transport Bureau, had never inspected the granaries along the canal, resulting in much theft, fraud, and spoilage. Sangge proposed that Vice Minister of War Taqar replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Qilai, darughachi of the Grain Transport Bureau, had never inspected the granaries along the canal, resulting in much theft, fraud, and spoilage. Sangge proposed that Vice Minister of War Taqar replace him.

sentences.zh: 自立尚書省，凡倉庫諸司，無不鉤考，先摘委六部官，復以為不專，乃置徵理司，以治財穀之當追者。

translations.literal: From the time the Imperial Secretariat was established, every warehouse and bureau was audited without exception. At first selected officials of the six ministries were assigned; then, thinking this was not specialized enough, the Bureau for Recovery was established to handle grain and funds that should be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: From the time the Imperial Secretariat was established, every warehouse and bureau was audited without exception. At first selected officials of the six ministries were assigned; then, thinking this was not specialized enough, the Bureau for Recovery was established to handle grain and funds that should be recovered.

sentences.zh: 時桑哥以理筭為事，毫分縷析，入倉庫者，無不破產，及當更代，人皆棄家而避之。

translations.literal: At that time Sangge made financial reckoning his business, analyzing every fraction and thread; those who entered the warehouses were without exception ruined, and when it came time for replacement, people all abandoned their households to avoid it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Sangge made financial reckoning his business, analyzing every fraction and thread. Those who entered the warehouses were without exception ruined, and when it came time for replacement, people all abandoned their households to avoid the post.

sentences.zh: 十月，桑哥奏：「湖廣行省錢穀，已責平章要束木自首償矣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Sangge memorialized: 「The funds and grain of the Huguang Regional Secretariat have already been made the responsibility of Grand Councillor Yissum Buga to confess and repay.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Sangge memorialized, "The funds and grain of the Huguang Regional Secretariat have already been made the responsibility of Grand Councillor Yissum Buga to confess and repay.

sentences.zh: 外省欺盜必多，乞以參政忻都、戶部尚書王巨濟、參議尚書省事阿散、山東西道提刑按察使何榮祖、札魯忽赤禿忽魯、泉府司卿李佑、奉御吉丁、監察御史戎益、僉樞密院事崔彧、尚書省斷事官燕真、刑部尚書安祐、監察御史伯顏等十二人，理筭江淮、江西、福建、四川、甘肅、安西六省，每省各二人，特給印章與之。

translations.literal: Outside provinces must have much fraud and theft. I request that twelve men—Vice Grand Councillor Xindu, Minister of Revenue Wang Juji, Associate Legislative Supervisor of Imperial Secretariat Affairs Asan, Surveillance Commissioner of the Shandong West Circuit He Rongzu, darughachi Tughluq, Director of the Quanfu Bureau Li You, Palace Attendant Jiding, Investigating Censor Rong Yi, Associate Administrator of the Bureau of Military Affairs Cui Yu, Adjudication Official of the Imperial Secretariat Yan Zhen, Minister of Justice An You, and Investigating Censor Boyan—conduct financial reckoning in the six provinces of Jianghuai, Jiangxi, Fujian, Sichuan, Gansu, and Anxi, two men per province, with special seals granted to them.
translations.idiomatic: Outside provinces must contain much fraud and theft. I request that twelve men—Vice Grand Councillor Xindu, Minister of Revenue Wang Juji, Associate Legislative Supervisor of Imperial Secretariat Affairs Asan, Surveillance Commissioner of the Shandong West Circuit He Rongzu, darughachi Tughluq, Director of the Quanfu Bureau Li You, Palace Attendant Jiding, Investigating Censor Rong Yi, Associate Administrator of the Bureau of Military Affairs Cui Yu, Adjudication Official of the Imperial Secretariat Yan Zhen, Minister of Justice An You, and Investigating Censor Boyan—conduct financial reckoning in the six provinces of Jianghuai, Jiangxi, Fujian, Sichuan, Gansu, and Anxi, two men per province, with special seals granted to them.

sentences.zh: 省部官既去，事不可廢，擬選人為代，聽食元俸。

translations.literal: Since the provincial and ministerial officials have departed, the business cannot be abandoned; it is proposed to select men as replacements, allowed to receive their original salaries.
translations.idiomatic: Since the provincial and ministerial officials have departed, the business cannot be abandoned. It is proposed to select men as replacements, allowed to receive their original salaries.

sentences.zh: 理筭之間，宜給兵以備使令，且以為衛。」

translations.literal: During the financial reckoning, soldiers should be provided to await orders and also serve as guards.」
translations.idiomatic: During the financial reckoning, soldiers should be provided to await orders and also serve as guards."

sentences.zh: 世祖皆從之。

translations.literal: Kublai approved all of it.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 當是時天下騷然，江淮尤甚，而諛佞之徒，方且諷都民史吉等為桑哥立石頌德，世祖聞之曰：「民欲立則立之，仍以告桑哥，使其喜也。」

translations.literal: At that time the empire was in turmoil, Jianghuai especially so, yet the flatterers were just then urging the capital clerk Shi Ji and others to erect a stone stele praising Sangge's virtue. Kublai heard of it and said: 「If the people wish to erect it, let them erect it. Still report it to Sangge so that he may be pleased.」
translations.idiomatic: At that time the empire was in turmoil, Jianghuai especially so, yet flatterers were just then urging the capital clerk Shi Ji and others to erect a stone stele praising Sangge's virtue. Kublai heard of it and said, "If the people wish to erect it, let them erect it. Still report it to Sangge so that he may be pleased."

sentences.zh: 於是翰林製文，題曰王公輔政之碑。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Hanlin Academy composed the text, entitled Stele of Lord Wang's Assistance in Government.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Hanlin Academy composed the text, entitled Stele of Lord Wang's Assistance in Government.

sentences.zh: 桑哥又以緫制院所統西蕃諸宣慰司，軍民財穀，事體甚重，宜有以崇異之，奏改為宣政院，秩從一品，用三臺銀印。

translations.literal: Sangge also held that because the General Regulation Bureau governed the various pacification commissions of the Western Regions, with military and civil affairs and funds and grain, the matter was very weighty and should be specially honored; he memorialized to change it to the Bureau of Tibetan and Buddhist Affairs, with rank equivalent to first grade, using the three-platform silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge also held that because the General Regulation Bureau governed the various pacification commissions of the Western Regions, with military and civil affairs and funds and grain, the matter was very weighty and should be specially honored. He memorialized to change it to the Bureau of Tibetan and Buddhist Affairs, with rank equivalent to first grade, using the three-platform silver seal.

sentences.zh: 世祖問所用何人，對曰：「臣與脫因。」

translations.literal: Kublai asked whom would be appointed. He replied: 「Your subject and Tuoyin.」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai asked whom would be appointed. He replied, "Your subject and Tuoyin."

sentences.zh: 於是命桑哥以開府儀同三司、尚書右丞相，兼宣政使，領功德使司事，脫因同為使。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sangge was ordered to serve with the ceremonial of a Grand General with the Honorific Guard of Three Divisions and as Right Chancellor of the Imperial Secretariat, concurrently Commissioner of the Bureau of Tibetan and Buddhist Affairs and head of the Bureau of Meritorious Deeds; Tuoyin was made commissioner as well.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Sangge was ordered to serve with the ceremonial of a Grand General with the Honorific Guard of Three Divisions and as right chancellor of the Imperial Secretariat, concurrently commissioner of the Bureau of Tibetan and Buddhist Affairs and head of the Bureau of Meritorious Deeds. Tuoyin was made commissioner as well.

sentences.zh: 世祖嘗召桑哥謂曰：「朕以葉李言，更至元鈔，所用者法，所貴者信，汝無以楮視之，其本不可失，汝宜識之。」

translations.literal: Kublai once summoned Sangge and said: 「On Ye Li's advice I revised the Zhiyuan notes. What is used is law; what is prized is trust. Do not regard them as mere paper. Their foundation must not be lost—you should keep this in mind.」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai once summoned Sangge and said, "On Ye Li's advice I revised the Zhiyuan notes. What is used is law; what is prized is trust. Do not regard them as mere paper. Their foundation must not be lost—you should keep this in mind."

sentences.zh: 二十六年，桑哥請鉤考甘肅行尚書省、及益都淄萊淘金緫管府，僉省趙仁榮、緫管明里等，皆以罪罷。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Sangge requested an audit of the Gansu Regional Imperial Secretariat and the Yidu-Zilai Gold-Washing Directorate-General. Associate Administrator Zhao Rongrong, Director-General Mingli, and others were all dismissed for their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, Sangge requested an audit of the Gansu Regional Imperial Secretariat and the Yidu-Zilai Gold-Washing Directorate-General. Associate Administrator Zhao Rongrong, Director-General Mingli, and others were all dismissed for their crimes.

sentences.zh: 世祖幸上都，桑哥言：「去歲陛下幸上都，臣日視內帑諸庫，今歲欲乘小輿以行，人必竊議。」

translations.literal: When Kublai went to Shangdu, Sangge said: 「Last year when Your Majesty went to Shangdu, your subject daily inspected the inner treasuries and various storehouses. This year, if you wish to travel in a small carriage, people will surely whisper about it.」
translations.idiomatic: When Kublai went to Shangdu, Sangge said, "Last year when Your Majesty went to Shangdu, your subject daily inspected the inner treasuries and various storehouses. This year, if you wish to travel in a small carriage, people will surely whisper about it."

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「聽人議之，汝乘之可也。」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「Let people talk. You may ride in it.」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "Let people talk. You may ride in it."

sentences.zh: 桑哥又奏：「近委省臣檢責左右司文簿，凡經監察御史稽照者，遺逸尚多。

translations.literal: Sangge again memorialized: 「Recently provincial ministers were assigned to inspect and hold accountable the ledgers of the Left and Right Departments. Of those that had been checked by investigating censors, many omissions still remain.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge again memorialized, "Recently provincial ministers were assigned to inspect and hold accountable the ledgers of the Left and Right Departments. Of those that had been checked by investigating censors, many omissions still remain.

sentences.zh: 自今當令監察御史即省部稽照，書姓名於卷末，苟有遺逸，易於歸罪。

translations.literal: From now on investigating censors should immediately check them at the secretariat and ministries, writing their names at the end of each volume. If there are omissions, blame will be easy to assign.
translations.idiomatic: From now on investigating censors should immediately check them at the secretariat and ministries, writing their names at the end of each volume. If there are omissions, blame will be easy to assign.

sentences.zh: 仍命侍御史堅童視之，失則連坐。」

translations.literal: Attendant Censor Jian Tong was also ordered to oversee it; if there was failure, collective punishment would follow.」
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Censor Jian Tong was also ordered to oversee it. If there was failure, collective punishment would follow."

sentences.zh: 世祖從之，乃笞監察御史四人。

translations.literal: Kublai approved, and four investigating censors were beaten.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai approved, and four investigating censors were beaten.

sentences.zh: 是後監察御史赴省部者，掾令史與之抗禮，但遣小吏持文簿置案而去，監察御史遍閱之，而臺綱廢矣。

translations.literal: After this, when investigating censors went to the secretariat and ministries, clerks and recorders treated them as equals; they merely sent junior clerks to place the ledgers on the desk and leave. The investigating censors looked through them all, and censorial authority was ruined.
translations.idiomatic: After this, when investigating censors went to the secretariat and ministries, clerks and recorders treated them as equals. They merely sent junior clerks to place the ledgers on the desk and leave. The investigating censors looked through them all, and censorial authority was ruined.

sentences.zh: 參政忻都既去，尋召赴闕。

translations.literal: After Vice Grand Councillor Xindu had departed, he was soon summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: After Vice Grand Councillor Xindu had departed, he was soon summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書王巨濟專任理筭，江淮省左丞相忙兀帶緫之。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Wang Juji was specially assigned to financial reckoning, with Left Chancellor Mangwutai of the Jianghuai Secretariat overseeing it.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Wang Juji was specially assigned to financial reckoning, with Left Chancellor Mangwutai of the Jianghuai Secretariat overseeing it.

sentences.zh: 閏十月，桑哥輔政碑成，樹于省前，樓覆其上而丹艧之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month, Sangge's stele on assisting in government was completed. It was erected before the secretariat, with a pavilion built over it and painted red.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month, Sangge's stele on assisting in government was completed. It was erected before the secretariat, with a pavilion built over it and painted red.

sentences.zh: 桑哥言：「國家經費既廣，歲入恒不償所出，以往歲計之，不足者餘百萬錠。

translations.literal: Sangge said: 「State expenditure is already vast, and annual revenue constantly fails to cover outlays. Calculating by past years, the shortfall exceeds a million ingots.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge said, "State expenditure is already vast, and annual revenue constantly fails to cover outlays. Calculating by past years, the shortfall exceeds a million ingots.

sentences.zh: 自尚書省鉤考天下財穀，賴陛下福，以所徵補之，未嘗斂及百姓。

translations.literal: Since the Imperial Secretariat audited the empire's funds and grain, relying on Your Majesty's good fortune, the shortfall was made up from what was recovered, and the people were never taxed for it.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Imperial Secretariat audited the empire's funds and grain, relying on Your Majesty's good fortune, the shortfall was made up from what was recovered, and the people were never taxed for it.

sentences.zh: 臣恐自今難用此法矣。

translations.literal: Your subject fears that from now on this method will be hard to use.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject fears that from now on this method will be hard to use.

sentences.zh: 何則？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 倉庫可徵者少，而盜者亦鮮矣，臣憂之。

translations.literal: What can be recovered from the warehouses is little, and thieves too are few. Your subject is worried.
translations.idiomatic: What can be recovered from the warehouses is little, and thieves too are few. Your subject is worried.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為鹽課每引今直中統鈔三十貫，宜增為一錠；

translations.literal: Your subject foolishly thinks that the salt levy per unit is now worth thirty strings of Zhongtong notes and should be increased to one ingot;
translations.idiomatic: Your subject foolishly thinks that the salt levy per unit is now worth thirty strings of Zhongtong notes and should be increased to one ingot;

sentences.zh: 茶每引今直五貫，宜增為十貫；

translations.literal: tea per unit is now worth five strings and should be increased to ten strings;
translations.idiomatic: tea per unit is now worth five strings and should be increased to ten strings;

sentences.zh: 酒醋稅課，江南宜增額十萬錠。

translations.literal: the wine and vinegar tax levy in Jiangnan should be increased by 100,000 ingots.
translations.idiomatic: the wine and vinegar tax levy in Jiangnan should be increased by 100,000 ingots.

sentences.zh: 內地五萬錠。

translations.literal: In the interior, 50,000 ingots.
translations.idiomatic: In the interior, 50,000 ingots.

sentences.zh: 協濟戶十八萬，自入籍至今十三年，止輸半賦，聞其力已完，宜增為全賦。

translations.literal: There are 180,000 auxiliary households. From registration to the present has been thirteen years; they pay only half the levy. I hear their capacity is now complete, and they should be increased to the full levy.
translations.idiomatic: There are 180,000 auxiliary households. From registration to the present has been thirteen years, and they pay only half the levy. I hear their capacity is now complete, and they should be increased to the full levy.

sentences.zh: 如此，則國用庶可支，臣等免於罪矣。」

translations.literal: In this way, state expenditure may perhaps be sustained, and your subject and the others may be spared guilt.」
translations.idiomatic: In this way, state expenditure may perhaps be sustained, and your subject and the others may be spared guilt."

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「如所議行之。」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「Carry it out as discussed.」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "Carry it out as discussed."

sentences.zh: 桑哥既專政，凡銓調內外官，皆由於己，而其宣敕，尚由中書，桑哥以為言，世祖乃命自今宣敕並付尚書省。

translations.literal: Once Sangge monopolized government, all appointments and transfers of internal and external officials were in his hands, yet their edicts of appointment still went through the Central Secretariat. Sangge spoke of this, and Kublai then ordered that from now on all edicts of appointment be entrusted to the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Once Sangge monopolized government, all appointments and transfers of internal and external officials were in his hands, yet their edicts of appointment still went through the Central Secretariat. Sangge spoke of this, and Kublai then ordered that from now on all edicts of appointment be entrusted to the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 由是以刑爵為貨而販之，咸走其門，入貴價以買所欲。

translations.literal: Thereupon punishment and rank became goods to be sold. All rushed to his gate, paying high prices to buy what they desired.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon punishment and rank became goods to be sold. All rushed to his gate, paying high prices to buy what they desired.

sentences.zh: 貴價入，則當刑者脫，求爵者得，綱紀大壞，人心駭愕。

translations.literal: When high prices were paid, those who should have been punished escaped, and those who sought titles obtained them. Discipline was greatly ruined, and hearts were struck with horror.
translations.idiomatic: When high prices were paid, those who should have been punished escaped, and those who sought titles obtained them. Discipline was greatly ruined, and hearts were struck with horror.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春，世祖畋於漷北，也里審班及也先帖木兒、徹里等，劾奏桑哥專權黷貨。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-eighth year, when Kublai was hunting north of Huo, Yelishiban together with Yes Temür, Cheli, and others impeached and memorialized that Sangge monopolized power and accepted bribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-eighth year, when Kublai was hunting north of Huo, Yelishiban together with Yes Temür, Cheli, and others impeached and memorialized that Sangge monopolized power and accepted bribes.

sentences.zh: 時不忽木出使，三遣人趣召之至，覲於行殿，世祖以問，不忽木對曰：「桑哥壅蔽聰明，紊亂政事，有言者即誣以他罪而殺之。

translations.literal: At that time Buqmu was on a mission. Three times men were dispatched to urge and summon him. He had an audience at the traveling palace. Kublai questioned him, and Buqmu replied: 「Sangge blocks and obscures Your Majesty's clarity, disordering government affairs. Whoever speaks out he immediately frames with some other crime and kills.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Buqmu was on a mission. Three times men were dispatched to urge and summon him. He had an audience at the traveling palace. Kublai questioned him, and Buqmu replied, "Sangge blocks and obscures Your Majesty's clarity, disordering government affairs. Whoever speaks out he immediately frames with some other crime and kills.

sentences.zh: 今百姓失業，盜賊蜂起，召亂在旦夕，非亟誅之，恐為陛下憂。」

translations.literal: Now the common people have lost their livelihoods, bandits are rising like bees, and the summons to chaos is within days. If he is not urgently executed, I fear it will become a worry for Your Majesty.」
translations.idiomatic: Now the common people have lost their livelihoods, bandits are rising like bees, and chaos may come at any moment. If he is not urgently executed, I fear it will become a worry for Your Majesty."

sentences.zh: 留守賀伯顏，亦嘗為世祖陳其奸欺。

translations.literal: Regent He Boyan had also once laid out his deceit and fraud before Kublai.
translations.idiomatic: Regent He Boyan had also once laid out his deceit and fraud before Kublai.

sentences.zh: 久而言者益衆，世祖始決意誅之。

translations.literal: After a long time those who spoke grew ever more numerous, and Kublai at last resolved to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time those who spoke grew ever more numerous, and Kublai at last resolved to execute him.

sentences.zh: 二月，世祖諭大夫月兒魯曰：「屢聞桑哥沮抑臺綱，杜言者之口，又嘗捶撻御史，其所罪者何事，當與辨之。」

translations.literal: In the second month, Kublai instructed Grand Counselor Yelü: 「I have repeatedly heard that Sangge obstructed censorial authority and stopped the mouths of those who spoke out. He also once beat censors. For what crimes were they punished? This should be debated and clarified.」
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Kublai instructed Grand Counselor Yelü, "I have repeatedly heard that Sangge obstructed censorial authority and stopped the mouths of those who spoke out. He also once beat censors. For what crimes were they punished? This should be debated and clarified."

sentences.zh: 桑哥等持御史李渠等已刷文卷至，令侍御史杜思敬等勘驗辨論，往復數四，桑哥等辭屈。

translations.literal: Sangge and the others brought the already altered document rolls of Censor Li Qu and the others, and Attendant Censor Du Sijing and others were ordered to examine, verify, and debate. Back and forth four times, Sangge and the others were defeated in argument.
translations.idiomatic: Sangge and the others brought the already altered document rolls of Censor Li Qu and the others, and Attendant Censor Du Sijing and others were ordered to examine, verify, and debate. Back and forth four times, Sangge and the others were defeated in argument.

sentences.zh: 明日，帝駐蹕大口，復召御史臺暨中書、尚書兩省官辨論。

translations.literal: The next day the Emperor halted at Daku and again summoned officials of the Censorate together with the Central and Imperial Secretariats to debate.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the Emperor halted at Daku and again summoned officials of the Censorate together with the Central and Imperial Secretariats to debate.

sentences.zh: 尚書省執卷奏曰：「前浙西按察使只必，因監燒鈔受贓至千錠，嘗檄臺征之，二年不報。」

translations.literal: The Imperial Secretariat held the rolls and memorialized: 「Former Surveillance Commissioner Zhibi of Zhexi, because he supervised note-burning, accepted bribes up to 1,000 ingots. The Censorate was once dispatched with an order to recover them, and for two years there was no report.」
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Secretariat held the rolls and memorialized, "Former Surveillance Commissioner Zhibi of Zhexi, because he supervised note-burning, accepted bribes up to 1,000 ingots. The Censorate was once dispatched with an order to recover them, and for two years there was no report."

sentences.zh: 思敬曰：「文之次第，盡在卷中，今尚書省拆卷持對，其弊可見。」

translations.literal: Sijing said: 「The sequence of the documents is all in the rolls. Now the Imperial Secretariat has split the rolls and holds them up for comparison—the fraud is visible.」
translations.idiomatic: Sijing said, "The sequence of the documents is all in the rolls. Now the Imperial Secretariat has split the rolls and holds them up for comparison—the fraud is visible."

sentences.zh: 速古兒赤闍里抱卷至前奏曰：「用朱印以封紙縫者，防欺弊也。

translations.literal: Sugurji Qili came forward holding the rolls and memorialized: 「Red seals are used to close the paper seams to prevent fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Sugurji Qili came forward holding the rolls and memorialized, "Red seals are used to close the paper seams to prevent fraud.

sentences.zh: 若輩為宰相，乃拆卷破印與人辨，是教吏為奸，當治其罪。」

translations.literal: You people serve as chancellors, yet you split the rolls and break the seals to debate with others—this is teaching clerks to commit fraud. Your crimes should be punished.」
translations.idiomatic: You people serve as chancellors, yet you split the rolls and break the seals to debate with others—this is teaching clerks to commit fraud. Your crimes should be punished."

sentences.zh: 世祖是之。

translations.literal: Kublai approved.
