translations.idiomatic: Kublai approved.

sentences.zh: 責御史臺曰：「桑哥為惡，始終四年，其奸贓暴著非一，汝臺臣難云不知。」

translations.literal: He rebuked the Censorate: 「Sangge did evil for four years from beginning to end. His fraud and corruption were manifest in more than one case. You censorial ministers can hardly say you did not know.」
translations.idiomatic: He rebuked the Censorate, "Sangge did evil for four years from beginning to end. His fraud and corruption were manifest in more than one case. You censorial ministers can hardly say you did not know."

sentences.zh: 中丞趙國輔對曰：「知之。」

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhao Guofu replied: 「We knew.」
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhao Guofu replied, "We knew."

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「知而不劾，自當何罪？」

translations.literal: Kublai said: 「Knowing yet not impeaching—what crime should that itself be?」
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "Knowing yet not impeaching—what crime should that itself be?"

sentences.zh: 思敬等對曰：「奪官追俸，惟上所裁。」

translations.literal: Sijing and the others replied: 「Deprivation of office and recovery of salary—only Your Majesty may decide.」
translations.idiomatic: Sijing and the others replied, "Deprivation of office and recovery of salary—only Your Majesty may decide."

sentences.zh: 數日不決。

translations.literal: Several days passed without a decision.
translations.idiomatic: Several days passed without a decision.

sentences.zh: 大夫月兒魯奏：「臺臣久任者當斥罷，新者存之。」

translations.literal: Grand Counselor Yelü memorialized: 「Censorial ministers who have served long should be dismissed, and the newly appointed should be retained.」
translations.idiomatic: Grand Counselor Yelü memorialized, "Censorial ministers who have served long should be dismissed, and the newly appointed should be retained."

sentences.zh: 乃仆桑哥輔政碑，下獄究問。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sangge's stele commemorating his service in government was toppled, and he was imprisoned for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Sangge's stele commemorating his service in government was toppled, and he was imprisoned for interrogation.

sentences.zh: 至七月，乃伏誅。

translations.literal: By the seventh month, he was executed after confessing.
translations.idiomatic: By the seventh month, he was executed after confessing.

sentences.zh: 平章要束木者，桑哥之妻黨，在湖廣時，正月朔日，百官會行省，朝服以俟。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Yissum Buga was a member of Sangge's wife's faction. When he was in Huguang, on the first day of the first month, all officials gathered at the regional secretariat in court dress to wait.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Yissum Buga was a member of Sangge's wife's faction. When he was in Huguang, on the first day of the first month, all officials gathered at the regional secretariat in court dress to wait.

sentences.zh: 要束木召至其家，受賀畢，方詣省要闕，賀如常儀。

translations.literal: Yissum Buga summoned them to his home; only after receiving congratulations there did he go to the secretariat to take his place at court, where congratulations proceeded as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Yissum Buga summoned them to his home, and only after receiving congratulations there did he go to the secretariat to take his place at court, where congratulations proceeded as usual.

sentences.zh: 又陰召卜者有不軌言。

translations.literal: He also secretly summoned diviners who spoke seditious words.
translations.idiomatic: He also secretly summoned diviners who spoke seditious words.

sentences.zh: 至是，中書列其罪以聞，世祖命械致湖廣，即其省戮之。

translations.literal: At this time the Central Secretariat listed his crimes and reported them. Kublai ordered him shackled and sent to Huguang, where he was executed in that province.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the Central Secretariat listed his crimes and reported them. Kublai ordered him shackled and sent to Huguang, where he was executed in that province.

sentences.zh: 鐵木迭兒者，木兒火赤之子也。

translations.literal: Temüder was the son of Mölikhöl.
translations.idiomatic: Temüder was the son of Mölikhöl.

sentences.zh: 嘗逮事世祖。

translations.literal: He had once served Kublai in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He had once served Kublai in succession.

sentences.zh: 成宗大德間，同知宣徽院事，兼通政院使。

translations.literal: During the Dade era of Emperor Chengzong, he was Associate Director of the Palace Domestic Service and concurrently Commissioner of the Bureau of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dade era of Emperor Chengzong, he was associate director of the Palace Domestic Service and concurrently commissioner of the Bureau of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，為宣徽使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wuzong acceded, he became Director of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong acceded, he became director of the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 至大元年，由江西行省平章政事，拜雲南行省左丞相。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhida, from Grand Councillor of the Jiangxi Regional Secretariat he was appointed Left Chancellor of the Yunnan Regional Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhida, from grand councillor of the Jiangxi Regional Secretariat he was appointed left chancellor of the Yunnan Regional Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 居二載，擅離職赴闕，尚書省奏，奉旨詰問，尋以皇太后旨，得貸罪還職。

translations.literal: After two years in office, he left his post without authorization and went to court. The Imperial Secretariat memorialized; by imperial order he was questioned, and soon, by the Empress Dowager's command, he was pardoned and returned to office.
translations.idiomatic: After two years in office, he left his post without authorization and went to court. The Imperial Secretariat memorialized, and by imperial order he was questioned. Soon, by the Empress Dowager's command, he was pardoned and returned to office.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，武宗崩，仁宗在東宮，以丞相三寶奴等變亂舊章，誅之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, Emperor Wuzong died. Emperor Renzong, then in the Eastern Palace, executed Chancellor Sanbanu and others for altering and disrupting the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, Emperor Wuzong died. Emperor Renzong, then in the Eastern Palace, executed Chancellor Sanbanu and others for altering and disrupting the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 用完澤及李孟為中書平章政事，銳欲更張庶務。

translations.literal: He appointed Öljei and Li Meng as grand councillors of the Central Secretariat and was keen to overhaul all administrative affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Öljei and Li Meng as grand councillors of the Central Secretariat and was keen to overhaul all administrative affairs.

sentences.zh: 而皇太后在興聖宮，已有旨，召鐵木迭兒為中書右丞相。

translations.literal: But the Empress Dowager, in Xingsheng Palace, had already issued an order summoning Temüder to be right chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: But the Empress Dowager, in Xingsheng Palace, had already issued an order summoning Temüder to be right chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 踰月，仁宗即位，因遂相之。

translations.literal: After a month, Emperor Renzong acceded, and Temüder was accordingly made chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: After a month, Emperor Renzong acceded, and Temüder was accordingly made chancellor.

sentences.zh: 及幸上都，命鐵木迭兒留守大都，平章完澤等奏：「故事，丞相留治京師者，出入得張蓋。

translations.literal: When the Emperor traveled to Shangdu, he ordered Temüder to remain and guard Dadu. Grand Councillor Öljei and others memorialized: 「By precedent, a chancellor who remains to govern the capital may have a canopy borne when going out.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor traveled to Shangdu, he ordered Temüder to remain and guard Dadu. Grand Councillor Öljei and others memorialized, "By precedent, a chancellor who remains to govern the capital may have a canopy borne when going out.

sentences.zh: 今右丞相鐵木迭兒大都居守，時方盛暑，請得張蓋如故事。」

translations.literal: Now Right Chancellor Temüder is holding Dadu in the heat of midsummer. We request that he be allowed a canopy as in precedent.」
translations.idiomatic: Now Right Chancellor Temüder is holding Dadu in the heat of midsummer. We request that he be allowed a canopy as in precedent."

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: This was granted.
translations.idiomatic: This was granted.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，制贈鐵木迭兒曾祖唆海翊運宣力保大功臣、太尉，諡武烈，祖不憐吉帶推誠保德定遠功臣、太尉，諡忠武；

translations.literal: That winter, an edict posthumously ennobled Temüder's great-grandfather Soqai as Grand Merit Lord Who Supported the Dynasty with Upholding Strength and Preserved Greatness, Grand Commandant, with the posthumous title Martial and Fierce; his grandfather Bulinjidai as Grand Merit Lord Who Pushed Forward Sincerity, Preserved Virtue, and Settled the Distance, Grand Commandant, with the posthumous title Loyal and Martial;
translations.idiomatic: That winter, an edict posthumously ennobled Temüder's great-grandfather Soqai as Grand Merit Lord Who Supported the Dynasty with Upholding Strength and Preserved Greatness, grand commandant, with the posthumous title Martial and Fierce; his grandfather Bulinjidai as Grand Merit Lord Who Pushed Forward Sincerity, Preserved Virtue, and Settled the Distance, grand commandant, with the posthumous title Loyal and Martial;

sentences.zh: 父木兒火赤推忠佐理同德功臣、太師，諡忠貞：並開府儀同三司、上柱國，追封歸德王。

translations.literal: his father Mölikhöl as Grand Merit Lord Who Pushed Forward Loyalty, Assisted in Governance, and Shared in Virtue, Grand Preceptor, with the posthumous title Loyal and Upright—all with the rank of Grand Master with the Privileges of an Imperial Secretary of State and Supreme Pillar of State, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guide.
translations.idiomatic: and his father Mölikhöl as Grand Merit Lord Who Pushed Forward Loyalty, Assisted in Governance, and Shared in Virtue, grand preceptor, with the posthumous title Loyal and Upright—all with the rank of grand master with the privileges of an imperial secretary of state and supreme pillar of state, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guide.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年三月，鐵木迭兒奏：「臣誤蒙聖恩，擢任中書，年衰且病，雖未能深達政體，思竭忠力，以圖報效，事有創行，敢不自勉，前省弊政，方與更新。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Huangqing, Temüder memorialized: 「I have undeservedly received the sage grace and been promoted to the Central Secretariat. I am old and ill; though I cannot deeply grasp the principles of governance, I intend to exhaust my loyalty and strength to repay my obligation. Where matters require new initiatives, I dare not fail to urge myself on. The former secretariat's corrupt policies are just now being renewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Huangqing, Temüder memorialized, "I have undeservedly received Your Majesty's grace and been promoted to the Central Secretariat. I am old and ill; though I cannot deeply grasp the principles of governance, I intend to exhaust my loyalty and strength to repay my obligation. Where matters require new initiatives, I dare not fail to urge myself on. The former secretariat's corrupt policies are just now being renewed.

sentences.zh: 欽惟列聖相承，混一區宇，日有萬幾，若非整飭，恐致解弛。

translations.literal: Reverently considering that the successive sage emperors inherited one another and unified the realm, with ten thousand affairs daily—if these are not put in order, I fear slackness will result.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently considering that the successive sage emperors inherited one another and unified the realm, with ten thousand affairs daily—if these are not put in order, I fear slackness will result.

sentences.zh: 繼今朝夕視事，左右司六部官有不盡心者，當論決，再不俊者，黜勿敘，其有託故僥倖他職者，亦不敘。」

translations.literal: From now on, in attending to business morning and evening, officials of the Left and Right Bureaus and the six ministries who do not devote themselves fully should be judged and decided upon; those who twice prove unworthy should be dismissed without reinstatement; those who use pretexts to seek other posts by luck should likewise not be reappointed.」
translations.idiomatic: From now on, in attending to business morning and evening, officials of the Left and Right Bureaus and the six ministries who do not devote themselves fully should be judged and decided upon; those who twice prove unworthy should be dismissed without reinstatement; those who use pretexts to seek other posts by luck should likewise not be reappointed."

sentences.zh: 仁宗是其言。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong approved his words.

sentences.zh: 既而以病去職。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he resigned on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 延祐改元，丞相哈散奏：「臣非世勳族姓，幸逢陛下為宰相，如丞相鐵木迭兒，練達政體，且嘗監修國史，乞授其印，俾領翰林國史院，軍國重務，悉令議之。」

translations.literal: When the era name was changed to Yanyou, Chancellor Hasan memorialized: 「I am not of a hereditary merit family. I was fortunate to be made chancellor by Your Majesty. Chancellor Temüder, however, is practiced in the principles of governance and has also supervised the compilation of the national history. I request that his seal be granted him, that he be put in charge of the Hanlin Academy and National History Office, and that all weighty affairs of state and army be deliberated with him.」
translations.idiomatic: When the era name was changed to Yanyou, Chancellor Hasan memorialized, "I am not of a hereditary merit family. I was fortunate to be made chancellor by Your Majesty. Chancellor Temüder, however, is practiced in the principles of governance and has also supervised the compilation of the national history. I request that his seal be granted him, that he be put in charge of the Hanlin Academy and National History Office, and that all weighty affairs of state and army be deliberated with him."

sentences.zh: 仁宗曰：「然。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong said: 「So be it.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong said, "So be it.

sentences.zh: 卿其啟諸皇太后。

translations.literal: You should inform the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: You should inform the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 與之印，大事必使預聞。」

translations.literal: Give him the seal; on great matters he must be made to hear in advance.」
translations.idiomatic: Give him the seal; on great matters he must be made to hear in advance.

sentences.zh: 遂拜開府儀同三司、監修國史、錄軍國重事。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was appointed Grand Master with the Privileges of an Imperial Secretary of State, Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, and Recorder of Weighty Affairs of State and Army.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he was appointed grand master with the privileges of an imperial secretary of state, supervisor of the compilation of the national history, and recorder of weighty affairs of state and army.

sentences.zh: 居數月，復拜中書右丞相，合散為左丞相。

translations.literal: After several months he was again appointed right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and Hasan became left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: After several months he was again appointed right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and Hasan became left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 鐵木迭兒奏：「蒙陛下憐臣，復擢為首相，依阿不言，誠負聖眷。

translations.literal: Temüder memorialized: 「Your Majesty took pity on me and again promoted me to chief minister. I have stood by docile and silent—truly I have failed Your Majesty's favor.
translations.idiomatic: Temüder memorialized, "Your Majesty took pity on me and again promoted me to chief minister. I have stood by docile and silent—truly I have failed Your Majesty's favor.

sentences.zh: 比聞內侍隔越奏旨者衆，倘非禁止，致治實難。

translations.literal: I have lately heard that many palace attendants overstep their bounds in memorializing the throne. If this is not forbidden, good governance will truly be difficult.
translations.idiomatic: I have lately heard that many palace attendants overstep their bounds in memorializing the throne. If this is not forbidden, good governance will truly be difficult.

sentences.zh: 請敕諸司，自今中書政務，毋輒干預。

translations.literal: I request that all offices be ordered that from now on they must not rashly interfere in the Central Secretariat's administrative affairs.
translations.idiomatic: I request that all offices be ordered that from now on they must not rashly interfere in the Central Secretariat's administrative affairs.

sentences.zh: 又往時富民，往諸蕃商販，率獲厚利，商者益衆，中國物輕，蕃貨反重。

translations.literal: Furthermore, in former times wealthy men who went to trade in the various foreign lands generally obtained thick profits; merchants grew ever more numerous, goods of China became cheap, and foreign goods in turn became costly.
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, in former times wealthy men who went to trade in the various foreign lands generally obtained thick profits. Merchants grew ever more numerous, goods of China became cheap, and foreign goods in turn became costly.

sentences.zh: 今請以江浙右丞曹立領其事，發舟十綱，給牒以往，歸則征稅如制；

translations.literal: Now I request that Right Vice Commissioner Cao Li of Jiang-Zhe be put in charge of this matter, that ten convoys of ships be dispatched, passports issued for the voyage, and on return taxes levied according to regulation;
translations.idiomatic: Now I request that Right Vice Commissioner Cao Li of Jiang-Zhe be put in charge of this matter, that ten convoys of ships be dispatched, passports issued for the voyage, and on return taxes levied according to regulation;

sentences.zh: 私往者，沒其貨。

translations.literal: those who go privately shall have their goods confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: those who go privately shall have their goods confiscated.

sentences.zh: 又，經用不給，苟不預為規畫，必至愆誤。

translations.literal: Furthermore, routine expenditures are insufficient; if plans are not made in advance, delay and error will inevitably result.
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, routine expenditures are insufficient; if plans are not made in advance, delay and error will inevitably result.

sentences.zh: 臣等集諸老議，皆謂動鈔本，則鈔法愈虛；

translations.literal: Your ministers assembled the senior officials to discuss this, and all said that moving the note reserve would make the note system ever more hollow;
translations.idiomatic: Your ministers assembled the senior officials to discuss this, and all said that moving the note reserve would make the note system ever more hollow;

sentences.zh: 加賦稅，則毒流黎庶；

translations.literal: increasing land tax would spread poison among the common people;
translations.idiomatic: increasing land tax would spread poison among the common people;

sentences.zh: 增課額，則比國初已倍五十矣。

translations.literal: raising the tax quota would mean it had already doubled fiftyfold compared with the founding of the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: raising the tax quota would mean it had already doubled fiftyfold compared with the founding of the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 惟預買山東、河間運使來歲鹽引，及各冶鐵貨，庶可以足今歲之用。

translations.literal: Only by pre-purchasing next year's salt certificates from the Shandong and Hejian transport commissioners, and iron goods from the various smelting offices, might this year's needs be met.
translations.idiomatic: Only by pre-purchasing next year's salt certificates from the Shandong and Hejian transport commissioners, and iron goods from the various smelting offices, might this year's needs be met.

sentences.zh: 又，江南田糧，往歲雖嘗經理，多未覈實。

translations.literal: Furthermore, the land tax of Jiangnan, though surveyed in past years, was in large part never verified.
translations.idiomatic: Furthermore, the land tax of Jiangnan, though surveyed in past years, was in large part never verified.

sentences.zh: 可始自江浙，以及江東、西，宜先事嚴限格、信罪賞，令田主手實頃畝狀入官，諸王、駙馬、學校、寺觀亦令如之；

translations.literal: One may begin from Jiang-Zhe and extend to Jiangdong and Jiangxi. Strict deadlines and reliable punishments and rewards should be set first, ordering landowners to submit by hand verified statements of acreage to the authorities; princes, imperial sons-in-law, schools, and temples and monasteries should likewise be required to do so;
translations.idiomatic: One may begin from Jiang-Zhe and extend to Jiangdong and Jiangxi. Strict deadlines and reliable punishments and rewards should be set first, ordering landowners to submit by hand verified statements of acreage to the authorities; princes, imperial sons-in-law, schools, and temples and monasteries should likewise be required to do so;

sentences.zh: 仍禁私匿民田，貴戚勢家，毋得沮撓。

translations.literal: private concealment of commoners' fields should still be forbidden, and noble and powerful families must not obstruct the effort.
translations.idiomatic: private concealment of commoners' fields should still be forbidden, and noble and powerful families must not obstruct the effort.

sentences.zh: 請敕臺臣協力以成，則國用足矣。」

translations.literal: I request that censorial ministers be ordered to cooperate to complete this, and then state revenue will suffice.」
translations.idiomatic: I request that censorial ministers be ordered to cooperate to complete this, and then state revenue will suffice.

sentences.zh: 仁宗皆從之。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong approved all of this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong approved all of this.

sentences.zh: 尋遣使者分行各省，括田增稅，苛急煩擾，江右為甚，致贛民蔡五九作亂寧都，南方騷動，遠近驚懼，乃罷其事。

translations.literal: Soon envoys were dispatched to the various provinces to register fields and increase taxes. The measures were harsh, urgent, and vexatious, worst in Jiangyou, leading the Ganzhou commoner Cai Wujiu to rebel at Ningdu. The south was thrown into turmoil, and near and far were alarmed and fearful; the project was then abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Soon envoys were dispatched to the various provinces to register fields and increase taxes. The measures were harsh, urgent, and vexatious, worst in Jiangyou, leading the Ganzhou commoner Cai Wujiu to rebel at Ningdu. The south was thrown into turmoil, and near and far were alarmed and fearful; the project was then abandoned.

sentences.zh: 明年，鐵木迭兒奏：「天下庶務，雖統於中書，而舊制，省臣亦分領之。

translations.literal: The following year, Temüder memorialized: 「The myriad affairs of the empire, though unified under the Central Secretariat, were by old regulation also divided among secretariat ministers for oversight.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Temüder memorialized, "The myriad affairs of the empire, though unified under the Central Secretariat, were by old regulation also divided among secretariat ministers for oversight.

sentences.zh: 請以錢帛、鈔法、刑名，委平章李孟、左丞阿卜海牙、參政趙世延等領之。

translations.literal: I request that currency and silk, the note system, and penal matters be entrusted to Grand Councillor Li Meng, Left Vice Commissioner Aq Buqa, Vice Grand Councillor Zhao Shiyan, and others to oversee.
translations.idiomatic: I request that currency and silk, the note system, and penal matters be entrusted to Grand Councillor Li Meng, Left Vice Commissioner Aq Buqa, Vice Grand Councillor Zhao Shiyan, and others to oversee.

sentences.zh: 其糧儲、選法、造作、驛傳，委平章張驢、右丞蕭拜住、參政曹從革等領之。」

translations.literal: Grain storage, selection regulations, construction, and courier posts should be entrusted to Grand Councillor Zhang Lü, Right Vice Commissioner Xiao Baizhu, Vice Grand Councillor Cao Congge, and others to oversee.」
translations.idiomatic: Grain storage, selection regulations, construction, and courier posts should be entrusted to Grand Councillor Zhang Lü, Right Vice Commissioner Xiao Baizhu, Vice Grand Councillor Cao Congge, and others to oversee.

sentences.zh: 得旨如所請。

translations.literal: Imperial approval was granted as requested.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial approval was granted as requested.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔諭中外，命右丞相鐵木迭兒緫宣政院事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, an edict was proclaimed within and without, appointing Right Chancellor Temüder to oversee all affairs of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, an edict was proclaimed within and without, appointing Right Chancellor Temüder to oversee all affairs of the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月，進位太師。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, he was promoted to Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, he was promoted to grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 十一月，大宗正府奏：「累朝舊制，凡議重刑，必決於蒙古大臣，今宜聽於太師右丞相。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Court of the Imperial Clan memorialized: 「By the old regulations of successive reigns, whenever heavy punishments were deliberated, the decision had to rest with Mongol ministers. Now this should be left to the Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor.」
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the Court of the Imperial Clan memorialized, "By the old regulations of successive reigns, whenever heavy punishments were deliberated, the decision had to rest with Mongol ministers. Now this should be left to the Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 鐵木迭兒既再入中書，居首相，怙勢貪虐，凶穢滋甚。

translations.literal: After Temüder had again entered the Central Secretariat and occupied the chief ministership, he relied on his power, was greedy and cruel, and his wickedness grew ever fouler.
translations.idiomatic: After Temüder had again entered the Central Secretariat and occupied the chief ministership, he relied on his power, was greedy and cruel, and his wickedness grew ever fouler.

sentences.zh: 於是蕭拜住自御史中丞為中書右丞，尋拜平章政事，稍牽制之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xiao Baizhu, from vice censor-in-chief, became right vice commissioner of the Central Secretariat, and soon was appointed grand councillor, slightly checking Temüder.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Xiao Baizhu, from vice censor-in-chief, became right vice commissioner of the Central Secretariat, and soon was appointed grand councillor, slightly checking Temüder.

sentences.zh: 而楊朶兒只自侍御史拜中丞，慨然以糾正其罪為己任。

translations.literal: Yang Tarchih, from attendant censor, was appointed vice censor-in-chief and took it upon himself with resolve to correct Temüder's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Tarchih, from attendant censor, was appointed vice censor-in-chief and took it upon himself with resolve to correct Temüder's crimes.

sentences.zh: 上都富人張弼殺人繫獄，鐵木迭兒使家奴脅留守賀伯顏，使出之，伯顏持正不可撓。

translations.literal: Zhang Bi, a wealthy man of Shangdu, was imprisoned for murder. Temüder sent a household slave to coerce Regent He Boyan to release him, but Boyan held firm and could not be bent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bi, a wealthy man of Shangdu, was imprisoned for murder. Temüder sent a household slave to coerce Regent He Boyan to release him, but Boyan held firm and could not be bent.

sentences.zh: 而朶兒只已廉得丞相所受張弼賂有顯徵，乃與拜住及伯顏奏之：「內外監察御史凡四十餘人，共劾鐵木迭兒桀黠姦貪，陰賊險狠，蒙上罔下，蠹政害民，布置爪牙，威讋朝野，凡可以誣陷善人、要功利己者，靡所不至。

translations.literal: Tarchih had already obtained clear evidence through investigation that the chancellor had accepted bribes from Zhang Bi. Thereupon, together with Baizhu and Boyan, he memorialized: 「More than forty investigating censors within and without jointly impeached Temüder as overbearing, cunning, treacherous, and greedy—secretly vicious, cruel, and ruthless, deceiving his superiors and misleading his subordinates, corrupting government and harming the people, deploying agents, and terrifying court and countryside. Whatever could frame good men or seize profit for himself, there was nothing he would not do.
translations.idiomatic: Tarchih had already obtained clear evidence through investigation that the chancellor had accepted bribes from Zhang Bi. Thereupon, together with Baizhu and Boyan, he memorialized, "More than forty investigating censors within and without jointly impeached Temüder as overbearing, cunning, treacherous, and greedy—secretly vicious, cruel, and ruthless, deceiving his superiors and misleading his subordinates, corrupting government and harming the people, deploying agents, and terrifying court and countryside. Whatever could frame good men or seize profit for himself, there was nothing he would not do.

sentences.zh: 取晉王田千餘畝、興教寺後壖園地三十畝、衛兵牧地二十餘畝。

translations.literal: He seized more than a thousand mu of the Prince of Jin's land, thirty mu of garden land behind Xingjiao Temple, and more than twenty mu of guard pasture.
translations.idiomatic: He seized more than a thousand mu of the Prince of Jin's land, thirty mu of garden land behind Xingjiao Temple, and more than twenty mu of guard pasture.

sentences.zh: 竊食郊廟供祀馬。

translations.literal: He secretly ate the horses supplied for suburban and temple sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly ate the horses supplied for suburban and temple sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 受諸王合兒班荅使人鈔十四萬貫，寶珠玉帶𣰽毺幣帛又計鈔十餘萬貫。

translations.literal: He accepted 140,000 strings of cash from the envoy of Prince Qoribanda, and pearls, jewels, jade belts, felt rugs, and silks amounting to more than 100,000 strings of cash besides.
translations.idiomatic: He accepted 140,000 strings of cash from the envoy of Prince Qoribanda, plus pearls, jewels, jade belts, felt rugs, and silks worth another 100,000-plus strings.

sentences.zh: 受杭州永興寺僧章自福賂金一百五十兩。

translations.literal: He accepted a bribe of one hundred fifty taels of gold from the monk Zhang Zifu of Yongxing Temple in Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He accepted a bribe of one hundred fifty taels of gold from the monk Zhang Zifu of Yongxing Temple in Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 取殺人囚張弼鈔五萬貫。

translations.literal: He took fifty thousand strings of cash from the murderer Zhang Bi.
translations.idiomatic: He took fifty thousand strings of cash from the murderer Zhang Bi.

sentences.zh: 且既已位極人臣，又領宣政院事，以其子八里吉思為之使。

translations.literal: Moreover, though he had already reached the summit among ministers, he also oversaw the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs and made his son Baljinai its commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, though he had already reached the summit among ministers, he also oversaw the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs and made his son Baljinai its commissioner.

sentences.zh: 諸子無功於國，盡居貴顯。

translations.literal: His sons, though without merit to the state, all held lofty and eminent posts.
translations.idiomatic: His sons, though without merit to the state, all held lofty and eminent posts.

sentences.zh: 縱家奴陵虐官府，為害百端。

translations.literal: He indulged household slaves to bully and abuse government offices, causing harm in countless ways.
translations.idiomatic: He indulged household slaves to bully and abuse government offices, causing harm in countless ways.

sentences.zh: 以致陰陽不和，山移地震，災異數見，百姓流亡，己乃恬然略無省悔。

translations.literal: The result was disharmony of yin and yang, mountains shifting and earthquakes, repeated portents and anomalies, and the common people fleeing in exile—yet he himself remained untroubled, with scarcely any reflection or repentance.
translations.idiomatic: The result was disharmony of yin and yang, mountains shifting and earthquakes, repeated portents and anomalies, and the common people fleeing in exile—yet he himself remained untroubled, with scarcely any reflection or repentance.

sentences.zh: 私家之富，又在阿合馬、桑哥之上。

translations.literal: The wealth of his private household exceeded even that of Ahmad and Sangge.
translations.idiomatic: The wealth of his private household exceeded even that of Ahmad and Sangge.

sentences.zh: 四海疾怨已久，咸願車裂斬首，以快其心。

translations.literal: Hatred and resentment throughout the four seas had long accumulated; all wished him torn apart by chariots or beheaded, to satisfy their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Hatred and resentment throughout the four seas had long accumulated; all wished him torn apart by chariots or beheaded, to satisfy their hearts.

sentences.zh: 如蒙早加顯戮，以示天下，庶使後之為臣者，知所警戒。」

translations.literal: If he might early be subjected to conspicuous execution to show the empire, perhaps later ministers would know what to fear.」
translations.idiomatic: If he might early be subjected to conspicuous execution to show the empire, perhaps later ministers would know what to fear.

sentences.zh: 奏既上，仁宗震怒，有詔逮問，鐵木迭兒匿興聖近侍家，有司不得捕。

translations.literal: After the memorial was submitted, Emperor Renzong was shaken with rage. An edict was issued to arrest and question Temüder, but Temüder hid in the home of a Xingsheng Palace attendant, and the authorities could not seize him.
translations.idiomatic: After the memorial was submitted, Emperor Renzong was shaken with rage. An edict was issued to arrest and question Temüder, but Temüder hid in the home of a Xingsheng Palace attendant, and the authorities could not seize him.

sentences.zh: 仁宗不樂者數日，又恐誠出皇太后意，不忍重傷咈之，乃僅罷其相位而已。

translations.literal: Emperor Renzong was displeased for several days, yet feared this truly came from the Empress Dowager's intent and could not bear to deeply wound her by going against it; he therefore merely removed Temüder from the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Renzong was displeased for several days, yet feared this truly came from the Empress Dowager's intent and could not bear to deeply wound her by going against it; he therefore merely removed Temüder from the chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 鐵木迭兒家居未逾年，又起為太子太師，中外聞之，莫不驚駭。

translations.literal: Temüder had been at home for less than a year when he was again raised to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent. Within and without the court, all who heard it were astonished and appalled.
translations.idiomatic: Temüder had been at home for less than a year when he was again raised to grand preceptor of the heir apparent. Within and without the court, all who heard it were astonished and appalled.

sentences.zh: 參政趙世延為御史中丞，率諸御史論其不法數十事，而內外御史論其不可輔導東宮者，又四十餘人。

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councillor Zhao Shiyan, as vice censor-in-chief, led the censors in listing several dozen of his unlawful acts, while censors within and without, arguing that he was unfit to guide the Eastern Palace, numbered more than forty.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councillor Zhao Shiyan, as vice censor-in-chief, led the censors in listing several dozen of his unlawful acts, while censors within and without, arguing that he was unfit to guide the Eastern Palace, numbered more than forty.

sentences.zh: 然以皇太后故，終不能明正其罪。

translations.literal: Yet because of the Empress Dowager, in the end his crimes could not be openly punished.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because of the Empress Dowager, in the end his crimes could not be openly punished.

sentences.zh: 明年正月辛丑，仁宗崩。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, on the day xinchou, Emperor Renzong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, on the day xinchou, Emperor Renzong died.

sentences.zh: 越四日，鐵木迭兒以皇太后旨，復入中書為右丞相。

translations.literal: Four days later, by the Empress Dowager's command, Temüder again entered the Central Secretariat as right chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Four days later, by the Empress Dowager's command, Temüder again entered the Central Secretariat as right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 又逾月，英宗猶在東宮，鐵木迭兒宣太后旨，召蕭拜住與朶兒只至徽政院，與徽攻院使失里門、御史大夫禿忒哈雜問之，責以前違太后旨，令伏罪。

translations.literal: After another month, while Emperor Yingzong was still in the Eastern Palace, Temüder proclaimed the Empress Dowager's command and summoned Xiao Baizhu and Tarchih to the Huizheng Court. Together with Huizheng Commissioner Shirimen and Censor-in-Chief Tutuqa they jointly interrogated them, charging them with having earlier defied the Empress Dowager's command and ordering them to confess their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: After another month, while Emperor Yingzong was still in the Eastern Palace, Temüder proclaimed the Empress Dowager's command and summoned Xiao Baizhu and Tarchih to the Huizheng Court. Together with Huizheng Commissioner Shirimen and Censor-in-Chief Tutuqa they jointly interrogated them, charging them with having earlier defied the Empress Dowager's command and ordering them to confess their crimes.

sentences.zh: 即起入奏，遽稱旨，執二人棄市。

translations.literal: He immediately rose, entered, and memorialized, abruptly claiming imperial approval, and had the two men seized and executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately rose, entered, and memorialized, abruptly claiming imperial approval, and had the two men seized and executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 是日，白晝晦冥，都人恟懼。

translations.literal: That day, though it was broad daylight, the sky turned dark; the people of the capital were alarmed and fearful.
translations.idiomatic: That day, though it was broad daylight, the sky turned dark; the people of the capital were alarmed and fearful.

sentences.zh: 英宗將行即位禮，鐵木迭兒恒病足，中書省啟：「祖宗以來，皇帝登極，中書率百官稱賀，班首惟上所命。」

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong was about to perform the accession rites, Temüder was chronically ill in the foot. The Central Secretariat reported: 「Since the ancestors, when an emperor acceded, the Central Secretariat led all officials in offering congratulations, and the lead position was only as the sovereign commanded.」
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong was about to perform the accession rites, Temüder was chronically ill in the foot. The Central Secretariat reported, "Since the ancestors, when an emperor acceded, the Central Secretariat led all officials in offering congratulations, and the lead position was only as the sovereign commanded.

sentences.zh: 英宗曰：「其以鐵木迭兒為之。」

translations.literal: Emperor Yingzong said: 「Let Temüder take that role.」
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong said, "Let Temüder take that role.

sentences.zh: 既即位，鐵木迭兒即奏委平章王毅、右丞高昉等徵理在京倉庫所貯糧，虧七十八萬石，責償於倉官及監臨出內者。

translations.literal: After he acceded, Temüder immediately memorialized entrusting Grand Councillor Wang Yi, Right Vice Commissioner Gao Fang, and others to audit the grain stored in the capital's warehouses. The shortfall was 780,000 shi; restitution was demanded from warehouse officials and those who supervised disbursement.
translations.idiomatic: After he acceded, Temüder immediately memorialized entrusting Grand Councillor Wang Yi, Right Vice Commissioner Gao Fang, and others to audit the grain stored in the capital's warehouses. The shortfall was 780,000 shi; restitution was demanded from warehouse officials and those who supervised disbursement.

sentences.zh: 所貢幣帛紕繆者，責償於本處官吏之董其事者。

translations.literal: Where tribute silks and fabrics were defective, restitution was demanded from the local officials who oversaw the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Where tribute silks and fabrics were defective, restitution was demanded from the local officials who oversaw the matter.

sentences.zh: 仍立程嚴督，違者杖之。

translations.literal: Schedules were also set with strict supervision; violators were beaten with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Schedules were also set with strict supervision; violators were beaten with the staff.

sentences.zh: 五月，英宗在上都，鐵木迭兒嫉留守賀伯顏素不附己，乃奏其以便服迎詔為不敬，下五府雜治，竟殺之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, while Emperor Yingzong was at Shangdu, Temüder resented Regent He Boyan, who had never attached himself to him. He memorialized that Boyan had received the edict in informal dress as a mark of disrespect. The case was sent to the Five Offices for joint trial, and in the end Boyan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, while Emperor Yingzong was at Shangdu, Temüder resented Regent He Boyan, who had never attached himself to him. He memorialized that Boyan had received the edict in informal dress as a mark of disrespect. The case was sent to the Five Offices for joint trial, and in the end Boyan was executed.

sentences.zh: 都民為之流涕。

translations.literal: The people of the capital wept for him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the capital wept for him.

sentences.zh: 趙世延時為四川行省平章政事，鐵木迭兒怒其昔嘗論己，方入相時，即從東宮啟英宗遣人逮捕之。

translations.literal: Zhao Shiyan was then grand councillor of the Sichuan Regional Secretariat. Temüder resented that he had once impeached him, and as soon as Temüder entered the chancellorship he reported through the Eastern Palace to Emperor Yingzong and had men dispatched to arrest Shiyan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shiyan was then grand councillor of the Sichuan Regional Secretariat. Temüder resented that he had once impeached him, and as soon as Temüder entered the chancellorship he reported through the Eastern Palace to Emperor Yingzong and had men dispatched to arrest Shiyan.

sentences.zh: 世延未至，鐵木迭兒使諷世延，啗以美官，令告引同時異己者，世延不肯從。

translations.literal: Before Shiyan arrived, Temüder sent word to hint to him, tempting him with a fine office and ordering him to inform against those who had opposed him at the same time. Shiyan refused to comply.
translations.idiomatic: Before Shiyan arrived, Temüder sent word to hint to him, tempting him with a fine office and ordering him to inform against those who had opposed him at the same time. Shiyan refused to comply.

sentences.zh: 至是，坐以違詔不敬，令法司窮治，請置極刑。

translations.literal: At this point he was charged with violating the edict and showing disrespect; the legal offices were ordered to investigate to the full and requested the extreme penalty.
translations.idiomatic: At this point he was charged with violating the edict and showing disrespect; the legal offices were ordered to investigate to the full and requested the extreme penalty.

sentences.zh: 英宗曰：「彼罪在赦前，所宜釋免。」

translations.literal: Emperor Yingzong said: 「His crime falls before the amnesty and should be released and pardoned.」
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong said, "His crime falls before the amnesty and should be released and pardoned.

sentences.zh: 鐵木迭兒對曰：「昔世延與省臺諸人謀害老臣，請究其姓名。」

translations.literal: Temüder replied: 「In the past Shiyan together with secretariat and censorial officials plotted to harm this old minister. I request that their names be investigated.」
translations.idiomatic: Temüder replied, "In the past Shiyan together with secretariat and censorial officials plotted to harm this old minister. I request that their names be investigated.

sentences.zh: 英宗曰：「事皆在赦前矣，又焉用問。」

translations.literal: Emperor Yingzong said: 「The matters all fall before the amnesty—what need is there to ask?」
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong said, "The matters all fall before the amnesty—what need is there to ask?

sentences.zh: 後數日，又奏世延當處死罪，又不允。

translations.literal: Several days later, he again memorialized that Shiyan should receive the death penalty, and again this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later, he again memorialized that Shiyan should receive the death penalty, and again this was not granted.

sentences.zh: 有司承望風旨，鍛鍊欲使自裁，世延終無所屈，賴英宗素聞其忠良，得免於死。

translations.literal: The responsible officials, reading the wind of intent, forged charges seeking to make him take his own life; Shiyan to the end was not broken, and relying on Emperor Yingzong's long knowledge of his loyalty and integrity, he escaped death.
translations.idiomatic: The officials in charge, catching the drift of Temüder's wishes, fabricated charges meant to drive Shiyan to suicide. Shiyan never wavered, and because Emperor Yingzong had long known him as loyal and upright, he was spared execution.

sentences.zh: 鐵木迭兒恃其權寵，乘間肆毒，睚眥之私，無有不報。

translations.literal: Temüder relied on his power and favor, seized opportunities to wreak harm, and for grudges no smaller than an eyelash, there was none he did not repay.
translations.idiomatic: Temüder traded on his power and imperial favor, seized every chance to strike, and repaid even the pettiest slights without fail.

sentences.zh: 英宗覺其所譖毀者，皆先帝舊人，滋不悅其所為，乃任拜住為左丞相，委以心腹。

translations.literal: Emperor Yingzong noticed that those he slandered were all old associates of the late emperor; he grew ever more displeased with his conduct and thereupon appointed Baizhu left chancellor, entrusting him as a confidant.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong saw that those Temüder slandered were all veterans of his father's court, and his displeasure deepened. He appointed Baizhu left chancellor and entrusted him as his inner confidant.

sentences.zh: 鐵木迭兒漸見疏外，以疾死于家。

translations.literal: Temüder gradually came to be distanced and estranged; he died of illness at home.
translations.idiomatic: Temüder was gradually pushed aside and estranged, and died of illness at home.

sentences.zh: 御史蓋繼元、宋翼，言其上負國恩，下失民望，生逃顯戮，死有餘辜。

translations.literal: Censors Gai Jiyuan and Song Yi said that above he betrayed the state's grace, below he lost the people's hope; living he escaped conspicuous execution, dead he still had guilt to spare.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Gai Jiyuan and Song Yi declared that Temüder had betrayed the state's grace above and forfeited the people's trust below; in life he had escaped public execution, yet in death his guilt still exceeded any punishment.

sentences.zh: 乃命毀所立碑，追奪其官爵及封贈制書，籍沒其家。

translations.literal: An order was issued to destroy the stele erected for him, posthumously strip his offices and titles and the patent documents of enfeoffment and gifts, and register and confiscate his household.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered his memorial stele destroyed, his offices and titles and all patents of enfeoffment posthumously revoked, and his household registered and confiscated.

sentences.zh: 子班丹，知樞密院事，尋以贓敗，不敘；

translations.literal: His son Bandan, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, soon after was ruined by corruption and was not reappointed;
translations.idiomatic: His son Bandan, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was soon disgraced by corruption and barred from further appointment;

sentences.zh: 鎖南，嘗為治書侍御史，其後鐵失弒英宗，鎖南以逆黨伏誅。

translations.literal: Suonang had once been supervising secretary censor; afterward Tieshi assassinated Emperor Yingzong, and Suonang was executed as a member of the rebellious faction.
translations.idiomatic: Suonang had once served as supervising secretary censor. After Tieshi assassinated Emperor Yingzong, Suonang was executed as a member of the rebel faction.

sentences.zh: 哈麻字士廉，康里人。

translations.literal: Hami, courtesy name Shilian, was a native of the Kangli tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Hami, courtesy name Shilian, was a native of the Kangli tribe.

sentences.zh: 父禿魯，母為寧宗乳母，禿魯以故封冀國公，加太尉，階金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: His father Tulu — whose wife had been wet nurse to Emperor Ningzong — for that reason was enfeoffed as Duke of Ji, advanced to grand commandant, and granted the rank of Grand Master with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tulu, whose wife had been wet nurse to Emperor Ningzong, was for that reason enfeoffed as Duke of Ji, promoted to grand commandant, and granted the rank of Grand Master with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 哈麻與其弟雪雪，早備宿衛，順帝深眷寵之。

translations.literal: Hami and his younger brother Xuexue early served in palace guard duty, and Emperor Shundi deeply favored and cherished them.
translations.idiomatic: Hami and his younger brother Xuexue entered palace guard service early on, and Emperor Shundi favored them deeply.

sentences.zh: 而哈麻有口才，尤為帝所褻幸，累遷官為殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: Hami moreover had a gift of speech and was especially treated with intimate favor by the emperor; through successive promotions he reached the office of attending palace censor.
translations.idiomatic: Hami was eloquent and enjoyed especially intimate favor from the emperor; through successive promotions he rose to attending palace censor.

sentences.zh: 雪雪累官集賢學士。

translations.literal: Xuexue rose through offices to academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Xuexue rose through the ranks to become academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies.

sentences.zh: 帝每即內殿與哈麻以雙陸為戲，一日，哈麻服新衣侍側，帝方啜茶，即噀茶於其衣。

translations.literal: The emperor would regularly go to the inner hall and play backgammon with Hami; one day Hami, wearing new clothes, attended at his side; the emperor was just sipping tea when he suddenly spat tea onto his garment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would often go to the inner hall to play backgammon with Hami. One day Hami, dressed in new clothes, stood at his side while the emperor was sipping tea; the emperor suddenly spat tea onto his garment.

sentences.zh: 哈麻親帝曰：「天子固當如是耶！」

translations.literal: Hami drew close to the emperor and said: 「Is this how a Son of Heaven ought to behave!」
translations.idiomatic: Hami drew close to the emperor and said, "Is this how a Son of Heaven ought to behave!

sentences.zh: 帝一笑而已。

translations.literal: The emperor merely smiled — and that was all.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor merely smiled — and that was all.

sentences.zh: 其被愛幸，無與為比。

translations.literal: The favor he received had no equal.
translations.idiomatic: The favor he enjoyed had no equal.

sentences.zh: 由是哈麻聲勢日盛，自藩王戚里，皆遺賂之。

translations.literal: From this Hami's power and prestige grew daily; from imperial princes to consort kin, all sent him gifts.
translations.idiomatic: From this Hami's power and prestige grew daily; from imperial princes to consort kin, all sent him gifts.

sentences.zh: 尋以謀害脫脫，出貶南安，召入為禮部尚書，俄遷同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Soon, for plotting against Toqto, he was demoted and exiled to Nan'an; he was recalled and made minister of rites, and soon after promoted to associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, for plotting against Toqto, he was demoted and exiled to Nan'an. He was later recalled as minister of rites and soon promoted to associate commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 至正初，脫脫為丞相，其弟也先帖木兒為御史大夫，哈麻日趨附其兄弟之門。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhizheng era, Toqto was chancellor and his younger brother Yesun Temür was censor-in-chief; Hami daily hurried to attach himself to their brothers' gate.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhizheng era, Toqto was chancellor and his younger brother Yesun Temür censor-in-chief; Hami daily hurried to attach himself to their household.

sentences.zh: 會脫脫去相位，而別兒怯不花為丞相，與脫脫有舊怨，頗欲中傷之，哈麻每於帝前力營護之，以故得免。

translations.literal: When Toqto left the chancellorship and Bie'erqiebuhua became chancellor — he bore an old grudge against Toqto and greatly wished to harm him — Hami each time vigorously protected him before the emperor, and for that reason Toqto escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: When Toqto left the chancellorship, Bie'erqiebuhua became chancellor. He bore an old grudge against Toqto and greatly wished to harm him, but Hami each time vigorously shielded Toqto before the emperor, and for that reason Toqto escaped injury.

sentences.zh: 初，別兒怯不花與太平、韓嘉納、禿滿迭兒等十人，結為兄弟，情好甚密。

translations.literal: Earlier, Bie'erqiebuhua together with Taiping, Han Jiana, Tumandier, and nine others had formed a sworn brotherhood; their affection was very close.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Bie'erqiebuhua together with Taiping, Han Jiana, Tumandier, and nine others had sworn brotherhood; their bond was very close.

sentences.zh: 及別兒怯不花既罷，九年，太平為左丞相，韓嘉納為御史大夫，乃謀黜哈麻，諷監察御史斡勒海壽，列其罪惡劾奏之：其小罪，則受宣讓王等駝馬諸物；

translations.literal: When Bie'erqiebuhua had already been dismissed, in the ninth year Taiping was left chancellor and Han Jiana censor-in-chief; they then plotted to remove Hami, hinting to supervising censor Walai Haishou to enumerate his crimes and impeach him: among lesser crimes, accepting camels, horses, and other goods from the Prince of Xuanrang and others;
translations.idiomatic: After Bie'erqiebuhua had been dismissed, in the ninth year Taiping became left chancellor and Han Jiana censor-in-chief. They plotted to remove Hami and hinted to supervising censor Walai Haishou to enumerate his crimes and impeach him: among lesser crimes, accepting camels, horses, and other goods from the Prince of Xuanrang and others;

sentences.zh: 其大者，則設帳房於御幄之後，無君臣之分。

translations.literal: among greater crimes, setting up a tent-office behind the imperial canopy, with no distinction between sovereign and minister.
translations.idiomatic: among greater crimes, setting up a tent-office behind the imperial canopy, with no distinction between sovereign and minister.

sentences.zh: 又，恃以提調寧徽寺為名，出入脫忽思皇后宮闈無間，犯分之罪尤大。

translations.literal: Moreover, relying on the title of overseer of Ninghui Temple as pretext, entering and leaving Empress Toghus's inner quarters without interval — the crime of violating proper bounds was especially grave.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, under the pretext of overseeing Ninghui Temple, he entered and left Empress Toghus's inner quarters without restraint — a crime of violating proper bounds especially grave.

sentences.zh: 寧徽寺者，掌脫忽思皇后錢糧，而脫忽思皇后，帝庶母也。

translations.literal: Ninghui Temple managed the finances and grain of Empress Toghus, and Empress Toghus was the emperor's stepmother.
translations.idiomatic: Ninghui Temple managed Empress Toghus's finances and grain supplies, and Empress Toghus was the emperor's stepmother.

sentences.zh: 哈麻知御史有所言，先已於帝前析其非罪，事皆太平、韓嘉納所摭拾。

translations.literal: Hami knew what the censors were saying and had already explained away the charges as not crimes before the emperor; the matters were all picked up and assembled by Taiping and Han Jiana.
translations.idiomatic: Hami learned what the censors were saying and had already explained away the charges before the emperor; the matters had all been gathered by Taiping and Han Jiana.

sentences.zh: 及韓嘉納以御史所言奏，帝大怒，斥弗納。

translations.literal: When Han Jiana reported what the censors had said, the emperor was greatly angered and rejected it, refusing to accept it.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Jiana reported what the censors had said, the emperor was greatly angered and refused to accept it.

sentences.zh: 明日，章再上，帝不得已，僅奪哈麻、雪雪官職，居之草地。

translations.literal: The next day the memorial was submitted again; the emperor had no choice and only stripped Hami and Xuexue of their offices, placing them on the grasslands.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the memorial was submitted again; the emperor had no choice and only stripped Hami and Xuexue of their offices, sending them to live on the grasslands.

sentences.zh: 而斡勒海壽為陝西廉訪副使，於是太平罷為翰林學士承旨，韓嘉納罷為宣政使，尋出為江浙行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Walai Haishou was made vice surveillance commissioner of Shaanxi; thereupon Taiping was dismissed to become chief academician of the Hanlin Academy, Han Jiana was dismissed to become commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance, and soon after was sent out as grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Walai Haishou was made vice surveillance commissioner of Shaanxi. Taiping was dismissed to chief academician of the Hanlin Academy, Han Jiana to commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance, and soon after sent out as grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 有頃，脫忽思皇后泣訴帝，謂御史所劾哈麻事為侵己，帝益怒，乃詔奪海壽官，屏歸田里，禁錮之。

translations.literal: Before long Empress Toghus wept and complained to the emperor that the censors' impeachment of Hami was an attack on herself; the emperor grew angrier still and issued an edict stripping Haishou of his office, sending him back to his home district in disgrace and imprisoning him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Empress Toghus wept and complained to the emperor that the censors' impeachment of Hami was an attack on her. The emperor grew angrier still and issued an edict stripping Haishou of his office, sending him home in disgrace and imprisoning him.

sentences.zh: 已而脫脫復為丞相，也先帖木兒復為御史大夫，而謫太平居陝西，而加韓嘉納以贓罪，杖流奴兒干以死。

translations.literal: Before long Toqto again became chancellor and Yesun Temür again censor-in-chief; Taiping was banished to live in Shaanxi, and Han Jiana was charged with corruption, beaten and exiled to Nürgan, where he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Toqto again became chancellor and Yesun Temür again censor-in-chief. Taiping was banished to Shaanxi, and Han Jiana was charged with corruption, beaten, and exiled to Nürgan, where he died.

sentences.zh: 別兒怯不花既罷，猶出居般陽，而禿滿迭兒自中書右丞出為四川右丞，亦誣以罪，追至中道殺之。

translations.literal: Though Bie'erqiebuhua had already been dismissed, he still went out to reside at Panyang; Tumandier, from right vice director of the Central Secretariat sent out as right vice director of Sichuan, was likewise falsely charged with a crime, pursued to the middle of the road, and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Though Bie'erqiebuhua had already been dismissed, he still went out to live at Panyang. Tumandier, sent from right vice director of the Central Secretariat to right vice director of Sichuan, was likewise falsely charged, pursued on the road, and killed.

sentences.zh: 已而哈麻復見召用，而脫脫兄弟尤德之。

translations.literal: Before long Hami was again summoned and employed, and the Toqto brothers were especially grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Hami was summoned back into service, and the Toqto brothers were especially grateful to him.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，哈麻拜中書添設右丞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year, Hami was appointed additionally established right vice director of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twelfth year, Hami was appointed additionally established right vice director of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，正除右丞。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year he received formal appointment as right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year he received formal appointment as right vice director.

sentences.zh: 時脫脫方信任汝中柏，由郎中為參議中書，自平章政事以下，見其議事，皆唯唯而已。

translations.literal: At that time Toqto deeply trusted Ru Zhongbai, who from bureau director became deliberator of the Secretariat; from associate grand councillor downward, when they saw him discuss affairs, all merely assented.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Toqto deeply trusted Ru Zhongbai, who rose from bureau director to deliberator of the Secretariat; from associate grand councillor downward, all who saw him discuss affairs merely assented.

sentences.zh: 獨哈麻性剛決，與之論，數不合，汝中柏因譖哈麻於脫脫。

translations.literal: Only Hami, by nature forceful and resolute, when debating with him frequently disagreed; Ru Zhongbai therefore slandered Hami to Toqto.
translations.idiomatic: Only Hami, forceful and resolute by nature, frequently disagreed with him in debate; Ru Zhongbai therefore slandered Hami to Toqto.

sentences.zh: 八月，出哈麻為宣政院使，又位居第三，哈麻由是深銜脫脫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Hami was sent out as commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance, yet also ranked third in precedence; Hami from this deeply harbored resentment against Toqto.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Hami was sent out as commissioner of the Court for the Spread of Governance, yet ranked only third in precedence; from this Hami deeply resented Toqto.

sentences.zh: 初，哈麻嘗陰進西天僧以運氣術媚帝，帝習為之，號演揲兒法。

translations.literal: Earlier, Hami had secretly introduced Western Heaven monks who used breath-circulation arts to flatter the emperor; the emperor learned to practice it, called the Yanaḍar method.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Hami had secretly introduced Western Heaven monks who used breath-circulation arts to flatter the emperor. The emperor learned the practice, called the Yanaḍar method.

sentences.zh: 演揲兒，華言大喜樂也。

translations.literal: Yanaḍar, in Chinese speech, means "great bliss."
translations.idiomatic: Yanaḍar, in Chinese, means "great bliss."

sentences.zh: 哈麻之妹壻集賢學士禿魯帖木兒，故有寵於帝，與老的沙、八郎、荅剌馬吉的、波迪哇兒禡等十人，俱號倚納。

translations.literal: Hami's sister's husband, academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies Tulu Temür, therefore enjoyed favor with the emperor; together with Laodasha, Balang, Daram Jide, Bodiwa'erma, and ten others, all were styled yina.
translations.idiomatic: Hami's brother-in-law, academician Tulu Temür, therefore enjoyed the emperor's favor. Together with Laodasha, Balang, Daram Jide, Bodiwa'erma, and others — ten in all — they were styled yina.

sentences.zh: 禿魯帖木兒性姦狡，帝愛之，言聽計從，亦薦西蕃僧伽璘真於帝。

translations.literal: Tulu Temür was by nature cunning and deceitful; the emperor loved him and followed his words and plans in all things; he also recommended the Western Tibetan monk Qalinzhen to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Tulu Temür was cunning and deceitful by nature; the emperor loved him and followed his every word and plan. He also recommended the Western Tibetan monk Qalinzhen to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 其僧善祕密法，謂帝曰：「陛下雖尊居萬乘，富有四海，不過保有見世而已。

translations.literal: That monk was skilled in secret methods and said to the emperor: 「Though Your Majesty is honored to occupy the ten-thousand-chariot throne and rich in possession of the four seas, you can only hold the visible world, that is all.
translations.idiomatic: That monk was skilled in secret methods and said to the emperor, "Though Your Majesty is honored to occupy the throne of ten thousand chariots and rich in the possession of all within the four seas, you can hold only the visible world — that is all.

sentences.zh: 人生能幾何，當受此祕密大喜樂禪定。」

translations.literal: How long is human life? You ought to receive this secret great-bliss meditation.」
translations.idiomatic: How long is human life? You ought to receive this secret great-bliss meditation.

sentences.zh: 帝又習之，其法亦名雙修法。

translations.literal: The emperor again learned it; the method was also called dual-practice dhyana.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor learned it as well; the method was also called dual-practice dhyana.

sentences.zh: 曰演揲兒，曰祕密，皆房中術也。

translations.literal: What is called Yanaḍar, what is called "secret" — all are bedchamber arts.
translations.idiomatic: What is called Yanaḍar, what is called "secret" — all are bedchamber arts.

sentences.zh: 帝乃詔以西天僧為司徒，西蕃僧為大元國師。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon issued an edict making the Western Heaven monk minister of education and the Western Tibetan monk Great Preceptor of the Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon issued an edict making the Western Heaven monk minister of education and the Western Tibetan monk Great Preceptor of the Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 其徒皆取良家女，或四人、或三人奉之，謂之供養。

translations.literal: His disciples all took daughters of good families — sometimes four, sometimes three — to attend them; this was called "offerings of support."
translations.idiomatic: His disciples all took daughters of good families — sometimes four, sometimes three — to attend them; this was called "offerings of support."

sentences.zh: 於是帝日從事於其法，廣取女婦，惟淫戲是樂。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor daily engaged in these methods, widely taking women, finding pleasure only in licentious sport.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor daily engaged in these methods, taking women widely and finding pleasure only in licentious sport.

sentences.zh: 又選采女為十六天魔舞。

translations.literal: He also selected tribute girls for the Sixteen Heavenly Demon Dance.
translations.idiomatic: He also selected tribute girls for the Sixteen Heavenly Demon Dance.

sentences.zh: 八郎者，帝諸弟，與其所謂倚納者，皆在帝前，相與褻狎，甚至男女裸處，號所處室曰皆即兀該，華言事事無礙也。

translations.literal: Balang was one of the emperor's younger brothers; together with those called yina, all were before the emperor, mutually treating one another with indecent familiarity, even men and women naked together; they called the room where they stayed Jiejijiwu'gai — in Chinese speech, "nothing forbidden in anything."
translations.idiomatic: Balang was one of the emperor's younger brothers. Together with those called yina, all were before the emperor, treating one another with indecent familiarity, even men and women naked together. They called the room where they stayed Jiejijiwu'gai — in Chinese, "nothing forbidden in anything."

sentences.zh: 君臣宣淫，而群僧出入禁中，無所禁止，醜聲穢行，著聞于外，雖市井之人，亦惡聞之。

translations.literal: Sovereign and ministers publicly indulged in lewdness, while bands of monks entered and left the forbidden precincts without any prohibition; foul reputations and filthy conduct became renowned abroad, and even market folk loathed to hear of them.
translations.idiomatic: Sovereign and ministers openly indulged in lewdness, while bands of monks entered and left the forbidden precincts without restraint. Foul reputations and filthy conduct became notorious abroad, and even common townsfolk loathed to hear of them.

sentences.zh: 皇太子年日以長，尤深疾禿魯帖木兒等所為，欲去之未能也。

translations.literal: The crown prince grew day by day older and especially deeply hated what Tulu Temür and the others were doing; he wished to remove them but could not.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince grew older by the day and especially hated what Tulu Temür and the others were doing. He wished to remove them but could not.

sentences.zh: 十四年秋，脫脫領大軍討高郵，哈麻乘間遂復入中書為平章政事。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourteenth year Toqto led a great army to campaign against Gaoyou; Hami seized the interval and again entered the Central Secretariat as associate grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourteenth year Toqto led a great army against Gaoyou. Hami seized the opportunity and again entered the Central Secretariat as associate grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 脫脫之出師也，以汝中柏為治書侍御史，俾輔也先帖木兒。

translations.literal: When Toqto marched out on campaign he made Ru Zhongbai supervising secretary censor to assist Yesun Temür.
translations.idiomatic: When Toqto marched out on campaign, he made Ru Zhongbai supervising secretary censor to assist Yesun Temür.

sentences.zh: 汝中柏累言哈麻必當屏斥，不然必為後患。

translations.literal: Ru Zhongbai repeatedly said Hami must be driven away, or else he would surely become a future threat.
translations.idiomatic: Ru Zhongbai repeatedly said Hami must be driven away, or he would surely become a future threat.

sentences.zh: 而也先帖木兒不從。

translations.literal: But Yesun Temür would not comply.
translations.idiomatic: But Yesun Temür would not comply.

sentences.zh: 哈麻知之，恐終不自保，因訴於皇后奇氏曰：「皇太子既立，而冊寶及郊廟之禮不行者，脫脫兄弟之意也。」

translations.literal: Hami learned of this and feared he would never preserve himself; he therefore complained to Empress Qi, saying: 「The crown prince having already been established, yet the rites of seal and tally and suburban and temple sacrifices not being performed — this is the intent of the Toqto brothers.」
translations.idiomatic: Hami learned of this and feared he could never save himself. He complained to Empress Qi, saying, "The crown prince has already been established, yet the rites of investiture and suburban and temple sacrifice have not been performed — this is the intent of the Toqto brothers.

sentences.zh: 皇后既頗信之，哈麻復與汪家奴之子桑哥實里、也先帖木兒之客明理明古，譖諸皇太子。

translations.literal: Empress Qi already rather believed this; Hami further joined with Wang Jianu's son Sangge Shirili and Yesun Temür's client Mingli Minggu in slandering the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Qi already rather believed this. Hami further joined with Wang Jianu's son Sangge Shirili and Yesun Temür's client Mingli Minggu in slandering the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 會也先帖木兒移疾家居，於是監察御史袁賽因不花等即承望哈麻風指，奏劾也先帖木兒罪惡，章凡三上，而帝始允，詔收御史臺印，令也先帖木兒出都門聽旨。

translations.literal: When Yesun Temür took illness and retired to his home, supervising censors Yuan Saoyinbuhua and others, immediately catching Hami's drift of intent, memorialized impeaching Yesun Temür for his crimes; the memorial was submitted three times altogether before the emperor finally assented; an edict confiscated the censorate seal and ordered Yesun Temür to leave the capital gate and await instructions.
translations.idiomatic: When Yesun Temür fell ill and retired home, supervising censors Yuan Saoyinbuhua and others, immediately catching Hami's drift, memorialized impeaching Yesun Temür for his crimes. The memorial was submitted three times before the emperor finally assented. An edict confiscated the censorate seal and ordered Yesun Temür to leave the capital gate and await instructions.

sentences.zh: 而遂以知樞密院事汪家奴為御史大夫。

translations.literal: And thereupon Wang Jianu, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jianu, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was thereupon made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 尋降詔數脫脫老師費財之罪，即軍中奪其兵柄，安置淮安。

translations.literal: Soon an edict enumerated Toqto's crimes of old age, tardiness, and waste of resources; his command of troops was immediately stripped in the army camp and he was resettled at Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict enumerated Toqto's crimes of old age, tardiness, and waste of resources. His command of troops was immediately stripped in camp and he was resettled at Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 既而脫脫、也先帖木兒皆就貶逐以死，並籍其家貲人口，而以所籍也先帖木兒者賜哈麻。

translations.literal: Before long both Toqto and Yesun Temür underwent demotion and exile to their deaths; their household wealth and persons were registered and confiscated together, and what had been registered from Yesun Temür was granted to Hami.
translations.idiomatic: Before long both Toqto and Yesun Temür were demoted and exiled to their deaths. Their household wealth and dependents were registered and confiscated together, and what had been seized from Yesun Temür was granted to Hami.

sentences.zh: 十五年四月，雪雪由知樞密院事拜御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year Xuexue, from commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year Xuexue, from commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五月，哈麻遂拜中書左丞相，國家大柄，盡歸其兄弟二人矣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Hami was then appointed left chancellor of the Central Secretariat; the great power of the state passed entirely into the hands of the two brothers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Hami was appointed left chancellor of the Central Secretariat; the great power of the state passed entirely into the hands of the two brothers.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，哈麻既為相，自以前所進蕃僧為恥，告其父禿魯曰：「我兄弟位居宰輔，宜導人主以正，今禿魯帖木兒專媚上以淫褻，天下士大夫必譏笑我，將何面目見人，我將除之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the following year, Hami having become chancellor, ashamed of the Tibetan monks he had previously introduced, told his father Tulu: 「We brothers occupy the rank of chief ministers and ought to guide the ruler toward the upright; now Tulu Temür devotedly flatters the sovereign with lewd obscenity — scholars throughout the realm will surely mock us; with what face can we meet others? I will remove him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the following year, Hami having become chancellor and ashamed of the Tibetan monks he had previously introduced, told his father Tulu, "We brothers occupy the rank of chief ministers and ought to guide the ruler toward the upright. Now Tulu Temür devotedly flatters the sovereign with lewd obscenity — scholars throughout the realm will surely mock us. With what face can we meet others? I will remove him.

sentences.zh: 且上日趨於昏暗，何以治天下，今皇太子年長，聰明過人，不若立以為帝，而奉上為太上皇。」

translations.literal: Moreover the sovereign daily declines toward darkness — how can he govern the realm? Now the crown prince is grown, his intelligence surpassing others; better to install him as emperor and install the present sovereign as retired emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the sovereign daily declines toward darkness — how can he govern the realm? The crown prince is now grown, his intelligence surpassing others. Better to install him as emperor and make the present sovereign retired emperor."

sentences.zh: 其妹聞之，歸告其夫。

translations.literal: His sister heard this and returned home to tell her husband.
translations.idiomatic: His sister heard this and returned home to tell her husband.

sentences.zh: 禿魯帖木兒恐皇太子為帝，則己必先見誅，即以聞于帝，然不敢斥言淫褻事，第曰「哈麻謂陛下年老故耳」。

translations.literal: Tulu Temür feared that if the crown prince became emperor he himself would first be executed; he immediately reported it to the emperor, yet did not dare speak openly of the lewd obscenity, only saying "Hami says it is because Your Majesty is old, that is all."
translations.idiomatic: Tulu Temür feared that if the crown prince became emperor he himself would be the first executed. He immediately reported it to the emperor, yet did not dare speak openly of the lewd obscenity, saying only, "Hami says it is because Your Majesty is old, that is all."

sentences.zh: 帝大驚曰：「朕頭未白，齒未落，遽謂我為老耶！」

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly startled and said: 「My hair is not yet white, my teeth have not yet fallen — and suddenly you call me old!」
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly startled and said, "My hair is not yet white, my teeth have not yet fallen — and suddenly you call me old!

sentences.zh: 帝即與禿魯帖木兒謀去哈麻、雪雪，計已定，禿魯帖木兒走匿尼寺中。

translations.literal: The emperor immediately plotted with Tulu Temür to remove Hami and Xuexue; once the plan was settled Tulu Temür fled and hid in a nunnery.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor immediately plotted with Tulu Temür to remove Hami and Xuexue. Once the plan was settled, Tulu Temür fled and hid in a nunnery.

sentences.zh: 明日，帝遣使傳旨哈麻與雪雪，毋早入朝，其家居聽旨。

translations.literal: The next day the emperor sent messengers to convey his command to Hami and Xuexue: do not enter court early; remain at home awaiting instructions.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the emperor sent messengers to convey his command to Hami and Xuexue: do not enter court early; remain at home awaiting instructions.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫搠思監，因劾奏哈麻與雪雪罪惡，帝曰：「哈麻、雪雪兄弟二人雖有罪，然侍朕日久，且與朕弟懿璘質班皇帝實同乳，可姑緩其罰，令其出征。」

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Suosijian thereupon memorialized impeaching Hami and Xuexue for their crimes; the emperor said: 「Although the Hami brothers are guilty, they have long served me and shared the same wet nurse as my brother, Emperor Yilin Zhiban; for the time being let their punishment be deferred and send them on campaign.」
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Suosijian thereupon memorialized impeaching Hami and Xuexue for their crimes. The emperor said, "Although the Hami brothers are guilty, they have long served me and shared the same wet nurse as my brother, Emperor Yilin Zhiban. For the time being let their punishment be deferred and send them on campaign.

sentences.zh: 已而中書右丞相定住、平章政事桑哥失里，復糾劾哈麻、雪雪之罪不已，乃命其兄弟出城受詔，遂詔哈麻於惠州安置，雪雪於肇州安置。

translations.literal: Before long Right Chancellor Dingzhu and Associate Grand Councillor Sangge Shili again repeatedly impeached the crimes of Hami and Xuexue without cease; the brothers were then ordered to leave the city to receive the edict; an edict resettled Hami at Huizhou and Xuexue at Zhaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Right Chancellor Dingzhu and Associate Grand Councillor Sangge Shili again repeatedly impeached the crimes of Hami and Xuexue without cease. The brothers were ordered to leave the city to receive the edict. An edict resettled Hami at Huizhou and Xuexue at Zhaozhou.

sentences.zh: 比行，俱杖死。

translations.literal: As they set out, both were beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: As they set out, both were beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 哈麻既死，仍籍其家財，也先帖木兒所封之庫藏，其封識固未嘗啟也。

translations.literal: After Hami died his household wealth was still registered and confiscated; the treasury sealed by Yesun Temür — its seals had never once been broken.
translations.idiomatic: After Hami died his household wealth was still registered and confiscated. The treasury sealed by Yesun Temür — its seals had never once been broken.

sentences.zh: 哈麻兄弟寵幸方固，而一旦遽見廢外，人皆謂帝怒其譖害脫脫兄弟之故，而不知其罪蓋由於不軌。

translations.literal: The Hami brothers' favor had just been firmly established when suddenly they were cast out; all said the emperor's anger was because they had slandered and harmed the Toqto brothers — yet they did not know their guilt in truth arose from treasonous intent.
translations.idiomatic: The Hami brothers' favor had just been firmly established when suddenly they were cast out. All said the emperor's anger was because they had slandered and harmed the Toqto brothers — yet they did not know their guilt in truth arose from treasonous intent.

sentences.zh: 其兄弟之死，人無恤之者。

translations.literal: At the brothers' deaths, no one pitied them.
translations.idiomatic: At the brothers' deaths, no one pitied them.

sentences.zh: 搠思監，怯烈氏，野先不花之孫，亦憐真之子也。

translations.literal: Suosijian was of the Qarluq tribe, grandson of Yexian Buhua and son of Yilianzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Suosijian was of the Qarluq tribe, grandson of Yexian Buhua and son of Yilianzhen.

sentences.zh: 早歲，性寬厚，簡言語，皆以遠大之器期之。

translations.literal: In his early years his nature was generous and mild, his speech sparing; all expected great capacity from him.
translations.idiomatic: In his early years his nature was generous and mild and his speech sparing; all expected great things of him.

sentences.zh: 泰定初，襲長宿衛，為必闍赤怯薛官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Taiding era he inherited long service in palace guard and became a bitikchi keshig officer.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Taiding era he inherited long service in the palace guard and became a bitikchi keshig officer.

sentences.zh: 至順二年，除內八府宰相。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhishun he was appointed minister of the Inner Eight Offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhishun he was appointed minister of the Inner Eight Offices.

sentences.zh: 元統初，出為福建宣慰使都元帥。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuantong era he was sent out as pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuantong era he was sent out as pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 居三年，通達政治，威惠甚著。

translations.literal: After three years in office he was thoroughly versed in governance; his authority and kindness were very notable.
translations.idiomatic: After three years in office he was thoroughly versed in governance; his authority and kindness were very notable.

sentences.zh: 後至元三年，拜江浙行中書省參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third year of the later Zhiyuan era he was appointed vice grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the later Zhiyuan era he was appointed vice grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 國用所倚，海運為重，是歲，搠思監被命督其役，措置有方，所漕米三百餘萬石，悉達京師，無耗折者。

translations.literal: On what state expenditure relied, sea transport was crucial; that year Suosijian was ordered to supervise the labor; his arrangements were well ordered; more than three million shi of transported grain all reached the capital with none lost or damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Sea transport was crucial to state expenditure. That year Suosijian was ordered to supervise the work. His arrangements were well ordered; more than three million shi of transported grain all reached the capital with none lost or damaged.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢湖北道肅政廉訪使，未行，改江浙行省右丞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of the Huguang Integrity Promotion Circuit; before he departed he was changed to right vice director of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of the Huguang Integrity Promotion Circuit; before he departed he was changed to right vice director of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 福建鹽法久壞，詔搠思監往究其私鬻、盜鬻及出納之弊，至則悉廉得其利病，為罷行之。

translations.literal: The Fujian salt monopoly had long been corrupt; an edict ordered Suosijian to go investigate the evils of private sales, theft of sales, and disbursement and receipt; upon arrival he thoroughly and fairly obtained the strengths and weaknesses and abolished and implemented reforms.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian salt monopoly had long been corrupt. An edict ordered Suosijian to investigate the evils of private sales, theft of sales, and irregular disbursement and receipt.
