Upon arrival he thoroughly and fairly identified the strengths and weaknesses and abolished abuses and implemented reforms.

sentences.zh: 至正元年，改山東肅政廉訪使，尋召拜中政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizheng, he was transferred to be Surveillance Commissioner for Rectifying Governance in Shandong, and soon was summoned and appointed Zhongzheng Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhizheng, he was transferred to be Surveillance Commissioner for Rectifying Governance in Shandong, and soon was summoned and appointed Zhongzheng Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，除陝西行臺御史中丞。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, he was appointed vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, he was appointed vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.

sentences.zh: 三月，復為中政使。

translations.literal: In the third month, he again became Zhongzheng Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, he again became Zhongzheng Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月，調太府卿。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, he was transferred to chamberlain of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, he was transferred to chamberlain of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 四年，拜中書參知政事，尋陞右丞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was appointed associate administrator of the Secretariat and was soon promoted to right vice chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he was appointed associate administrator of the Secretariat and was soon promoted to right vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷御史中丞，遂除翰林學士承旨，俄復為中丞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was transferred to vice censor-in-chief, then appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin, and before long again became vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, he was transferred to vice censor-in-chief, then appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin, and before long again became vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 又由資政使遷宣徽使。

translations.literal: He also moved from Zizheng Commissioner to Xuanhui Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He also moved from Zizheng Commissioner to Xuanhui Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九年，除大宗正府也可扎魯火赤，宗正國人咸稱其明果。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was appointed yeke jarghuchi of the Court of the Imperial Clan; the clansmen in the court all praised his clarity and decisiveness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, he was appointed yeke jarghuchi of the Court of the Imperial Clan; the clansmen in the court all praised his clarity and decisiveness.

sentences.zh: 尋復入中書為右丞。

translations.literal: Soon he again entered the Secretariat as right vice chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he again entered the Secretariat as right vice chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，陞平章政事，階光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, he was promoted to manager of governmental affairs, with the rank Grand Master of Brilliant Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year, he was promoted to manager of governmental affairs, with the rank Grand Master of Brilliant Blessing.

sentences.zh: 十一年十一月，拜御史大夫，進銀青榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year, he was appointed Censor-in-Chief and advanced to Grand Master for Glorious Blessing with Silver Seal and Blue Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year, he was appointed Censor-in-Chief and advanced to Grand Master for Glorious Blessing with Silver Seal and Blue Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月，復為中書平章，從丞相脫脫平徐州有功。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, he again became manager of affairs in the Secretariat and won merit by following Chancellor Toqto'a in pacifying Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twelfth year, he again became manager of affairs in the Secretariat and won merit by following Chancellor Toqto'a in pacifying Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十三年，復拜御史大夫，尋又為中書平章。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he was again appointed Censor-in-Chief and soon again became manager of affairs in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, he was again appointed Censor-in-Chief and soon again became manager of affairs in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十四年九月，奉命率師討賊淮南，身先士卒，面中流矢不為動。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourteenth year, ordered to lead troops to suppress bandits in Huainan, he went before the soldiers; though an arrow struck his face he did not stir.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourteenth year, ordered to lead troops against bandits in Huainan, he went before his soldiers. Though an arrow struck his face he did not stir.

sentences.zh: 十五年，遷陝西行省平章，復召還，拜知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred as grand councillor of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, then recalled and appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was transferred as grand councillor of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, then recalled and appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 俄復拜中書平章，兼大司農分司，提調大都留守司，及屯田事。

translations.literal: Soon he was again appointed associate grand councillor of the Secretariat, concurrently chief of the Grand Agribureau branch office, overseeing the capital's palace commission and garrison-farm affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was again appointed associate grand councillor of the Secretariat, concurrently chief of the Grand Agribureau branch office, overseeing the capital palace commission and garrison-farm affairs.

sentences.zh: 一日，入侍，帝見其面有箭瘢，深歎閔焉。

translations.literal: One day, entering attendance, the emperor saw the arrow scar on his face and sighed deeply in pity.
translations.idiomatic: One day, entering attendance, the emperor saw the arrow scar on his face and sighed deeply in pity.

sentences.zh: 進為首平章。

translations.literal: He was advanced to senior associate grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to senior associate grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 十六年，復遷御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was again transferred to censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was again transferred to censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 四月，遂拜中書左丞相，明年三月，進右丞相。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was then appointed left chancellor of the Central Secretariat; in the third month of the following year he was promoted to right chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was appointed left chancellor of the Central Secretariat; in the third month of the following year he was promoted to right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十八年，加太保，詔封其曾祖孛魯海為雲王，祖也先不花為瀛王，父亦憐真為冀王。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was advanced to grand preceptor; an edict enfeoffed his great-grandfather Boluohai as Prince of Yun, his grandfather Yexian Buhua as Prince of Ying, and his father Yilianzhen as Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was advanced to grand preceptor. An edict enfeoffed his great-grandfather Boluohai as Prince of Yun, his grandfather Yexian Buhua as Prince of Ying, and his father Yilianzhen as Prince of Ji.

sentences.zh: 是時，天下多故日已甚，外則軍旅煩興，疆宇日蹙；

translations.literal: At this time troubles throughout the realm daily worsened; externally armies were repeatedly raised and the territory daily shrank;
translations.idiomatic: At this time troubles throughout the realm worsened daily; externally armies were repeatedly raised and the territory shrank day by day;

sentences.zh: 內則帑藏空虛，用度不給；

translations.literal: internally the treasury was empty and expenditures could not be met;
translations.idiomatic: internally the treasury was empty and expenditures could not be met;

sentences.zh: 而帝方溺於娛樂，不恤政務。

translations.literal: while the emperor was still drowning in amusements, untroubled by affairs of government.
translations.idiomatic: while the emperor was still drowning in amusements, untroubled by affairs of government.

sentences.zh: 於是搠思監居相位久，無所匡救，而又公受賄賂，貪聲著聞，物議喧然。

translations.literal: Thereupon Suosijian had long held the chancellorship, remedied nothing, and moreover openly accepted bribes; his reputation for greed was well known, and public opinion was in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: By then Suosijian had held the chancellorship for a long time without remedying anything, and he openly accepted bribes besides. His reputation for greed was notorious, and public opinion was in uproar.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，監察御史燕赤不花，劾奏搠思監任用私人朶列及妾弟崔完者帖木兒印造偽鈔，事將敗，令朶列自殺以滅口。

translations.literal: That winter, investigating censor Yanchi Buhua memorialized impeaching Suosijian for employing his private associate Duolie and his concubine's younger brother Cui Wanzhe Temür to print counterfeit banknotes; when the affair was about to be exposed, he had Duolie kill himself to silence witnesses.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, investigating censor Yanchi Buhua impeached Suosijian for employing his private associate Duolie and his concubine's younger brother Cui Wanzhe Temür to print counterfeit banknotes. When the affair was about to be exposed, he had Duolie kill himself to silence witnesses.

sentences.zh: 搠思監乃請謝事，解機務，詔止收其印綬。

translations.literal: Suosijian thereupon requested to resign from office and relinquish affairs of state; an edict only took back his seal and cord.
translations.idiomatic: Suosijian thereupon asked to resign and relinquish affairs of state. An edict merely took back his seal and cord of office.

sentences.zh: 而御史荅里麻失里、王彝言不已，帝終不聽也。

translations.literal: Yet censors Dalil Mashi and Wang Yi spoke without cease, and the emperor in the end would not heed them.
translations.idiomatic: Yet censors Dalil Mashi and Wang Yi kept speaking out, and the emperor in the end would not heed them.

sentences.zh: 會遼陽賊勢張甚，明年，遂起為遼陽行省左丞相，未行。

translations.literal: It happened that rebel forces in Liaoyang were very strong; the next year he was recalled as left chancellor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, but did not set out.
translations.idiomatic: As rebel forces in Liaoyang were growing very strong, the next year he was recalled as left chancellor of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat, but never set out.

sentences.zh: 二十年三月，復拜中書右丞相，仍降詔諭天下。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twentieth year he was again appointed right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and an edict was again issued proclaiming this to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twentieth year he was again appointed right chancellor of the Central Secretariat, and an edict was again issued proclaiming this throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 時帝益厭政，而宦者資正院使朴不花，乘間用事為姦利，搠思監因與結搆相表裏，四方警報及將臣功狀，皆壅不上聞。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor grew ever more weary of government, while the eunuch Pak Buha, director of the Correct Resources Office, seized the opportunity to wield power for illicit gain; Suosijian therefore joined with him in collusion, inside and out, and alarms from the four quarters and reports of generals' achievements were all blocked and did not reach the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was growing ever more weary of government, while the eunuch Pak Buha, director of the Correct Resources Office, seized the opportunity to wield power for illicit gain. Suosijian joined him in collusion, and alarms from the four quarters and reports of generals' achievements were all blocked from reaching the throne.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒、擴廓帖木兒各擁強兵于外，以權勢相軋，釁隙遂成。

translations.literal: Boluo Timur and Köke Timur each held strong armies abroad and clashed in power and influence; enmity thus formed.
translations.idiomatic: Boluo Timur and Köke Timur each commanded strong armies in the provinces and clashed over power and influence, and enmity thus formed between them.

sentences.zh: 搠思監與朴不花黨於擴廓帖木兒，而誣孛羅帖木兒以非罪。

translations.literal: Suosijian and Pak Buha allied with Köke Timur and falsely charged Boluo Timur with crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Suosijian and Pak Buha allied with Köke Timur and falsely charged Boluo Timur with crimes.

sentences.zh: 二十四年三月，帝因下詔削奪其官爵，且命擴廓帖木兒以兵討之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year the emperor thereupon issued an edict stripping Boluo Timur of his offices and titles, and ordered Köke Timur to suppress him with troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year the emperor issued an edict stripping Boluo Timur of his offices and titles and ordered Köke Timur to suppress him with troops.

sentences.zh: 而宗王不顏帖木兒、禿堅帖木兒等皆稱兵與孛羅帖木兒合，表言其無罪。

translations.literal: But the imperial princes Buyan Temür, Toqto'a Timur, and others all raised troops and joined Boluo Timur, memorializing that he was guiltless.
translations.idiomatic: But the imperial princes Buyan Temür, Toqto'a Timur, and others all took up arms and joined Boluo Timur, memorializing that he was innocent.

sentences.zh: 於是帝為降詔曰：「自至正十一年妖賊竊發，屬嘗選命將相，分任乃職，視同心膂，凡厥庶政，悉以委之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor issued an edict saying: 「Since the eleventh year of Zhizheng, when demonic rebels secretly rose, We have repeatedly selected and appointed generals and chancellors, assigning each his duty, treating them as of one heart and backbone; We have entrusted them with all ordinary government.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor issued an edict saying, "Since the eleventh year of Zhizheng, when demonic rebels secretly rose, We have repeatedly selected and appointed generals and chancellors, assigning each his duty and treating them as of one heart and backbone. We have entrusted them with all ordinary government.

sentences.zh: 豈期搠思監、朴不花夤緣為姦，互相壅蔽，以致在外宣力之臣，因而解體；

translations.literal: Who could have expected Suosijian and Pak Buha to take advantage of opportunities for wickedness, mutually blocking and concealing, so that ministers abroad exerting their strength thereby fell apart;
translations.idiomatic: Who could have expected Suosijian and Pak Buha to seize every opportunity for wickedness and mutually block and conceal affairs, so that ministers abroad exerting their strength fell apart;

sentences.zh: 在內忠良之士，悉陷非辜。

translations.literal: loyal and worthy men within were all trapped in unjust guilt.
translations.idiomatic: and loyal and worthy men within were all trapped in unjust guilt.

sentences.zh: 又復奮其私讎，誣搆孛羅帖木兒、老的沙等同謀不軌。

translations.literal: Again they pursued their private vendettas, fabricating charges that Boluo Timur, Laodesha, and others were conspiring treason.
translations.idiomatic: Again they pursued their private vendettas, fabricating charges that Boluo Timur, Laodesha, and others were conspiring treason.

sentences.zh: 朕以信任之專，失於究察，遂調兵往討。

translations.literal: Because of Our exclusive trust, We failed to investigate thoroughly and thus dispatched troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Because of Our exclusive trust, We failed to investigate thoroughly and thus dispatched troops to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒已嘗陳詞，而乃寢匿不行。

translations.literal: Boluo Timur had already presented his defense, yet it was suppressed and not acted upon.
translations.idiomatic: Boluo Timur had already presented his defense, yet it was suppressed and never acted upon.

sentences.zh: 今宗王不顏帖木兒等，仰畏明威，遠來控訴，以表其情，朕為惻然興念，而搠思監、朴不花猶飾虛詞，簧惑朕聽。

translations.literal: Now the imperial princes Buyan Temür and others, in awe of Our enlightened majesty, came from afar to lodge complaints and express their feelings; We were moved to compassion upon reflection, yet Suosijian and Pak Buha still clothed their words in falsehood and played upon Our ears with flattery.
translations.idiomatic: Now the imperial princes Buyan Temür and others, in awe of Our enlightened majesty, came from afar to lodge complaints and express their feelings. We were moved to compassion upon reflection, yet Suosijian and Pak Buha still clothed their words in falsehood and played upon Our ears with flattery.

sentences.zh: 其以搠思監屏諸嶺北，朴不花竄之甘肅，以快衆憤。

translations.literal: Let Suosijian be banished beyond the northern passes and Pak Buha be exiled to Gansu, to satisfy public outrage.
translations.idiomatic: Let Suosijian be banished beyond the northern passes and Pak Buha be exiled to Gansu, to satisfy public outrage.

sentences.zh: 孛羅帖木兒等，悉與改正，復其官職。」

translations.literal: Boluo Timur and the others shall all be cleared and restored to their offices.」
translations.idiomatic: Boluo Timur and the others shall all be cleared and restored to their offices.

sentences.zh: 然詔書雖下，而搠思監、朴不花仍留京師。

translations.literal: Yet although the edict was issued, Suosijian and Pak Buha still remained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yet although the edict was issued, Suosijian and Pak Buha still remained in the capital.

sentences.zh: 四月，孛羅帖木兒乃遣禿堅鐵木兒稱兵犯闕，必得搠思監、朴不花乃已。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Boluo Timur sent Toqto'a Temür to take up arms and assault the imperial precincts, declaring he would not cease until he had Suosijian and Pak Buha.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Boluo Timur sent Toqto'a Temür to take up arms and assault the imperial precincts, declaring he would not cease until he had Suosijian and Pak Buha.

sentences.zh: 帝不得已，縛二人畀之，遂皆為孛羅鐵木兒所殺。

translations.literal: The emperor, having no choice, bound the two men and handed them over; both were then killed by Boluo Timur.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, having no choice, bound the two men and handed them over. Both were then killed by Boluo Timur.

sentences.zh: 已而監察御史復奏言：「搠思監矯殺丞相太平，盜用鈔板，私家草詔，任情放選，鬻獄賣官，費耗庫藏，居廟堂前後十數年，使天下八省之地，悉致淪陷。

translations.literal: Before long a supervising censor again memorialized: 「Suosijian wrongly executed Chancellor Taiping, stole and used printing plates for paper money, privately drafted edicts, capriciously granted selections for office, sold justice and bought and sold offices, wasted and depleted the treasury; holding power in the Hall of State for some ten years or more, he caused all the territory of the realm's eight provinces to fall into ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Before long a supervising censor again memorialized: "Suosijian wrongly executed Chancellor Taiping, stole and used printing plates for paper money, privately drafted edicts, capriciously granted selections for office, sold justice and bought and sold offices, wasted and depleted the treasury. Holding power in the Hall of State for some ten years or more, he caused all the territory of the realm's eight provinces to fall into ruin.

sentences.zh: 乃誤國之姦臣，究其罪惡，大赦難原。

translations.literal: He was a treacherous minister who misled the state; considering the full extent of his crimes, even a general amnesty could hardly excuse them.
translations.idiomatic: He was a treacherous minister who misled the state. Considering the full extent of his crimes, even a general amnesty could hardly excuse them.

sentences.zh: 曩者，姦臣阿合馬之死，剖棺戮尸，搠思監之罪，視阿合馬為有過。

translations.literal: In the past, when the treacherous minister Ahmad died, his coffin was opened and his corpse dismembered; Suosijian's crimes exceed those of Ahmad.
translations.idiomatic: In the past, when the treacherous minister Ahmad died, his coffin was opened and his corpse dismembered. Suosijian's crimes exceed those of Ahmad.

sentences.zh: 今其雖死，必剖棺戮尸為宜。」

translations.literal: Now that he is dead, it would be appropriate to open his coffin and dismember his corpse.」
translations.idiomatic: Now that he is dead, it would be appropriate to open his coffin and dismember his corpse.

sentences.zh: 有旨從之。

translations.literal: An imperial order approved it.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial order approved it.

sentences.zh: 而臺臣言猶不已，遂復沒其家產，而竄其子宣徽使觀音奴於遠方。

translations.literal: Yet the censorial officials still would not cease their accusations; his household property was again confiscated, and his son, Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Guanyinu, was exiled to a distant place.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the censorial officials still would not cease their accusations. His household property was again confiscated, and his son, Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Guanyinu, was exiled to a distant place.

sentences.zh: 怯烈氏四世為丞相者八人，世臣之家，鮮與比盛。

translations.literal: Eight men of the Qarluq clan served as chancellor over four generations—a hereditary ministerial house rarely matched in eminence.
translations.idiomatic: Eight men of the Qarluq clan served as chancellor over four generations—a hereditary ministerial house rarely matched in eminence.

sentences.zh: 而搠思監早有才望，及居相位，人皆仰其有為，遭時多事，顧乃守之以懦，濟之以貪，遂使天下至於亂亡而不可為。

translations.literal: Yet Suosijian had early won repute for talent; once he held the chancellorship, all looked up to him as a man of action. Confronting a time of many troubles, he nonetheless met them with timidity and answered them with greed, until the realm was brought to chaos and ruin beyond remedy.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Suosijian had early won repute for talent, and once he held the chancellorship all looked up to him as a man of action. Confronting a time of many troubles, he nonetheless met them with timidity and answered them with greed, until the realm was brought to chaos and ruin beyond remedy.

sentences.zh: 論者謂元之亡，搠思監之罪居多云。

translations.literal: Commentators held that among the crimes leading to the Yuan's fall, Suosijian's ranked foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators held that among the crimes leading to the Yuan's fall, Suosijian's ranked foremost.
